title.zh: 卷四十六 本紀第四十六 度宗
title.raw: 卷四十六 本紀第四十六 度宗 Volume 46 Annals 46: Duzong

sentences.zh: 度宗端文明武景孝皇帝，諱禥，太祖十一世孫。

translations.literal: Emperor Duzong, titled Duantwen Mingwu Jingxiao, personal name Qi, was an eleventh-generation descendant of Emperor Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor Duzong, posthumous name Duantwen Mingwu Jingxiao, bore the personal name Qi and was a descendant of Emperor Taizu in the eleventh generation.

sentences.zh: 父嗣榮王與芮，理宗母弟也。

translations.literal: His father was Succeeding Prince of Rong Zhao Yourui, a younger maternal brother of Emperor Lizong.
translations.idiomatic: His father was Zhao Yourui, Prince of Rong in succession, the younger maternal brother of Emperor Lizong.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年四月九日生於紹興府榮邸。

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the fourth month of the fourth year of Jiaxi, he was born at the Rong princely residence in Shaoxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on the ninth day of the fourth month in the fourth year of Jiaxi at the Rong princely residence in Shaoxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，榮文恭王夫人全氏夢神言：「帝命汝孫，然非汝家所有。

translations.literal: At first, Lady Quan, consort of Prince Rong Wengong, dreamed that a spirit said: "The Emperor has commanded that your grandson [shall reign], yet he will not belong to your household."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Lady Quan, consort of Prince Rong Wengong, dreamed that a spirit said, "Heaven has ordained your grandson, yet he will not remain in your family."

sentences.zh: 」嗣榮王夫人錢氏夢日光照東室，是夕，齊國夫人黃氏亦夢神人采衣擁一龍納懷中，已而有娠。

translations.literal: Lady Qian, consort of the Succeeding Prince of Rong, dreamed that sunlight shone into the eastern chamber; that same night, Lady Huang of Qi also dreamed that a divine figure in colored robes embraced a dragon and placed it in her bosom, and thereafter she conceived.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Qian, consort of the Succeeding Prince of Rong, dreamed that sunlight filled the eastern chamber; that same night Lady Huang of Qi likewise dreamed of a divine figure in colored robes embracing a dragon and placing it in her bosom, and soon after she became pregnant.

sentences.zh: 及生，室有赤光。

translations.literal: When he was born, red light filled the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: At his birth, red light filled the room.

sentences.zh: 資識內慧，七歲始言，言必合度，理宗奇之。

translations.literal: Naturally intelligent within, he did not speak until age seven, and whenever he spoke his words were always apt, which Emperor Lizong found remarkable.
translations.idiomatic: Endowed with innate intelligence, he did not speak until he was seven, and whatever he said was always measured and fitting, which Emperor Lizong found extraordinary.

sentences.zh: 及在位歲久，無子，乃屬意托神器焉。

translations.literal: After he had been on the throne for many years without a son, he therefore set his hopes on entrusting the imperial regalia to him.
translations.idiomatic: After many years on the throne without an heir, Emperor Lizong therefore fixed his hopes on entrusting the imperial succession to him.

sentences.zh: 淳祐六年十月己丑，賜名孟啟，以皇侄授貴州刺史，入內小學。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the tenth month of the sixth year of Chunyou, he was granted the name Mengqi, appointed Prefect of Guizhou in the capacity of the emperor's nephew, and entered the Inner Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the tenth month of the sixth year of Chunyou, he was granted the name Mengqi, appointed Prefect of Guizhou as the emperor's nephew, and entered the inner academy.

sentences.zh: 七年正月乙卯，授宜州觀察使，就王邸訓習。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the first month of the seventh year, he was appointed Military Commissioner of Yizhou and undertook training at the princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the first month of the seventh year, he was appointed Military Commissioner of Yizhou and received instruction at the princely residence.

sentences.zh: 九年正月乙巳，授慶遠軍節度使，封益國公。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, on the day yisi of the first month, he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Qingyuan Army and enfeoffed as Duke of Yiguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on yisi in the first month, he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Qingyuan Army and enfeoffed as Duke of Yiguo.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月壬戌，改賜名孜，進封建安郡王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, on the day renxu of the first month, he was granted the changed name Zi and advanced to Prince of Jian'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on renxu in the first month, he was granted the new name Zi and advanced to Prince of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 寶祐元年正月庚辰，詔立爲皇子，改賜今名。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoyou, on the day gengchen of the first month, an edict established him as imperial prince and granted his present name.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoyou, on gengchen in the first month, an edict named him imperial prince and granted his present name Qi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，授崇慶軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封永嘉郡王。

translations.literal: On guiwei, he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Chongqing Army and Grand Preceptor with the privilege of an independent office equal to the Three Excellencies, and advanced to Prince of Yongjia Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Chongqing Army and Grand Preceptor with privileges equal to the Three Excellencies, and advanced to Prince of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，以宗正少卿蔡抗兼翊善。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court Cai Kang was made concurrent Tutor-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court Cai Kang was appointed concurrent tutor-in-attendance.

sentences.zh: 時資善堂初建，理宗制《堂記》，書以賜王。

translations.literal: At that time the Hall of Excellence in Goodness was newly built; Emperor Lizong composed "A Record of the Hall" and presented it in his own hand to the prince.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Excellence in Goodness had just been built; Emperor Lizong composed a record of the hall and presented it in his own hand to the prince.

sentences.zh: 十月癸酉，進封忠王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on guiyou, he was advanced to Prince of Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guiyou, he was advanced to Prince of Zhong.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，加元服，賜字邦壽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, he received the capping ceremony and was granted the style Bangshou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin, he underwent the capping ceremony and was granted the style Bangshou.

sentences.zh: 五年十月庚子，授鎮南、遂安軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year, on gengzi, he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhennan and Sui'an armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year, on gengzi, he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhennan and Suian armies.

sentences.zh: 景定元年六月壬寅，立爲皇太子，賜字長源，命楊棟、葉夢鼎爲太子詹事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingding, on the day renyin of the sixth month, he was established as heir apparent, granted the style Changyuan, and Yang Dong and Ye Mengding were appointed Grand Mentors of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingding, on renyin in the sixth month, he was established as heir apparent, granted the style Changyuan, and Yang Dong and Ye Mengding were appointed grand mentors of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，太子入東宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on dingmao, the heir apparent entered the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingmao, the heir apparent took up residence in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，行冊禮。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the investiture ceremony was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the formal investiture ceremony was held.

sentences.zh: 時理宗家教甚嚴，雞初鳴問安，再鳴回宮，三鳴往會議所參決庶事。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Lizong's household instruction was very strict: at the first cockcrow he paid his respects, at the second he returned to the palace, and at the third he went to the council chamber to take part in deciding various affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Lizong's household discipline was severe: at the first cockcrow the heir paid his respects, at the second he returned to the palace, and at the third he went to the council chamber to deliberate on routine affairs.

sentences.zh: 退入講堂，講官講經，次講史，終日手不釋卷。

translations.literal: He withdrew to the lecture hall, where the lecturers expounded the classics and then history; all day his hand never left his scroll.
translations.idiomatic: He then withdrew to the lecture hall, where lecturers expounded the classics and then history, and throughout the day he never set his books aside.

sentences.zh: 將晡，復至榻前起居，率爲常。

translations.literal: Toward dusk he again came before the couch to pay his respects, which became his constant practice.
translations.idiomatic: Toward evening he again presented himself before the imperial couch, and this became his daily routine.

sentences.zh: 理宗問今日講何經，答之是，則賜坐賜茶；

translations.literal: Emperor Lizong would ask which classic had been lectured on that day; if the answer was correct, he was granted a seat and tea;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Lizong would ask which classic had been covered that day; if the heir answered correctly, he was invited to sit and offered tea;

sentences.zh: 否，則爲之反覆剖析；

translations.literal: if not, the emperor would analyze it for him again and again;
translations.idiomatic: if not, the emperor would go over it with him again and again;

sentences.zh: 又不通，則繼以怒，明日須更覆講。

translations.literal: if he still did not understand, anger followed, and the next day he had to lecture on it again.
translations.idiomatic: if he still failed to grasp it, the emperor's anger followed, and he had to cover the same material again the next day.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丁丑，謁孔子於太學，請以張栻、呂祖謙列從祀。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the day dingchou of the first month, he paid homage to Confucius at the Imperial Academy and requested that Zhang Shi and Lü Zuqian be ranked among those accorded secondary sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on dingchou in the first month, he paid homage to Confucius at the Imperial Academy and petitioned that Zhang Shi and Lü Zuqian be granted secondary sacrifice in the temple.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，冊永嘉郡夫人全氏爲皇太子妃。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guimao, Lady Quan, Madame of Yongjia Commandery, was invested as consort of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guimao, Lady Quan of Yongjia was invested as consort of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年十月丁卯，理宗崩。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year, on dingmao, Emperor Lizong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year, on dingmao, Emperor Lizong passed away.

sentences.zh: 受遺詔，太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Having received the testamentary edict, the heir apparent assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the testamentary edict, the heir apparent ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，尊皇后謝氏曰皇太后，生日爲壽崇節。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Empress Xie was honored as empress dowager, and her birthday was designated the Festival of Longevity and Esteem.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Empress Xie was elevated to empress dowager, and her birthday was established as the Festival of Longevity and Esteem.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宰執、文武百官詣祥曦殿表請聽政，不允。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the chief ministers and civil and military officials of all ranks went to Xiangxi Hall and submitted a memorial requesting that he assume governance; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the chief ministers and the full civil and military bureaucracy went to Xiangxi Hall and petitioned him to take up governance; he refused.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，宰執以下日表請視朝，不允。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renshen, the chief ministers and those below submitted daily memorials requesting that he hold court audience; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renshen, the chief ministers and officials below them submitted daily memorials asking him to hold court; he again refused.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，凡七表，始從。

translations.literal: On dingchou, after seven memorials in all, he finally assented.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, after seven such petitions, he finally assented.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，帝初聽政，御後殿，命馬廷鸞、留夢炎兼侍讀，李伯玉、陳宗禮、範東叟兼侍講，何基、徐幾兼崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the emperor for the first time assumed governance, holding court in the rear hall, and appointed Ma Tingluan and Liu Mengyan concurrent Readers-in-Attendance, Li Boyu, Chen Zongli, and Fan Dongsou concurrent Lecturers-in-Attendance, and He Ji and Xu Ji concurrent Expositors of the Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the emperor assumed governance for the first time, holding audience in the rear hall. He appointed Ma Tingluan and Liu Mengyan as concurrent readers-in-attendance, Li Boyu, Chen Zongli, and Fan Dongsou as concurrent lecturers-in-attendance, and He Ji and Xu Ji as concurrent expositors of the Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 詔求直言。

translations.literal: An edict sought forthright counsel.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for forthright counsel.

sentences.zh: 又詔先朝舊臣趙葵、謝方叔、程元鳳、馬光祖、李曾伯各上言以匡不逮。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered former ministers of the previous reign—Zhao Kui, Xie Fangshu, Cheng Yuanfeng, Ma Guangzu, and Li Zengbo—each to submit memorials to remedy the emperor's shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict instructed former ministers of the previous reign—Zhao Kui, Xie Fangshu, Cheng Yuanfeng, Ma Guangzu, and Li Zengbo—to submit memorials correcting whatever the emperor might overlook.

sentences.zh: 召江萬里、王爚、洪天錫、湯漢等赴闕。

translations.literal: Jiang Wanli, Wang Ye, Hong Tiansi, Tang Han, and others were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Wanli, Wang Ye, Hong Tiansi, Tang Han, and others were summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔躬行三年喪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that he personally observe the three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded that he personally observe the full three-year mourning period.

sentences.zh: 復濟王竑元贈少師、節度使，追封鎮王，諡昭肅，有司討論墳制增修之。

translations.literal: The former posthumous gifts to Prince Ji Zhao Hong of Junior Mentor and military commissioner were restored; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zhen with the posthumous title Zhaosu, and the relevant offices were ordered to deliberate on augmenting his tomb regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The former posthumous honors for Zhao Hong, Prince Ji—Junior Mentor and military commissioner—were restored; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zhen with the title Zhaosu, and the relevant offices were instructed to revise and enlarge his tomb regulations.

sentences.zh: 加封嗣榮王與芮武康、寧江軍節度使，依前太師、判宗正事。

translations.literal: Succeeding Prince of Rong Zhao Yourui was further enfeoffed as Military Commissioner of the Wukang and Ningjiang armies, retaining his former posts as Grand Preceptor and Administrator of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yourui, Succeeding Prince of Rong, was further appointed Military Commissioner of the Wukang and Ningjiang armies while retaining his former offices as Grand Preceptor and Administrator of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 詔撫勞邊防將士。

translations.literal: An edict ordered consolation and rewards for frontier garrison officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that frontier officers and soldiers be comforted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 監察御史劾宦官李忠輔、何舜卿等贓罪，並竄遠方。

translations.literal: The surveillance censor impeached the eunuchs Li Zhongfu, He Shunqing, and others for corruption, and they were all banished to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: A surveillance censor impeached the eunuchs Li Zhongfu, He Shunqing, and others on charges of corruption, and all were banished to distant posts.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔儒臣日侍經筵，輔臣觀講。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict ordered Confucian scholars to attend the Classics Lecture daily and assisting ministers to observe the lectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, an edict required Confucian scholars to attend the daily Classics Lecture and ordered assisting ministers to observe the sessions.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命洪天錫以侍御史兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Hong Tiansi was appointed Attending Censor with concurrent service as Reader-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Hong Tiansi was appointed attending censor with concurrent duty as reader-in-attendance.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，詔改明年爲咸淳元年，行銅錢關子，率貫以七百七十文足。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, an edict changed the following year to the first year of Xianchun, put copper cash and guanzi notes into circulation, and fixed the rate at seven hundred seventy cash per full string.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, an edict renamed the coming year as the first year of Xianchun, put copper cash and treasury notes into circulation, and set the standard exchange at seven hundred seventy cash per full string.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，戒贓吏絕貢羨餘。

translations.literal: On renyin, corrupt officials were admonished to cease presenting surplus tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, corrupt officials were warned to stop presenting surplus tribute to their superiors.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔以生日爲乾會節。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict established his birthday as the Festival of Qianhui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, an edict established his birthday as the Festival of Qianhui.

sentences.zh: 初開經筵，講殿以熙明爲名。

translations.literal: When the Classics Lecture was first opened, the lecture hall was named Ximing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Classics Lecture was first convened, the lecture hall was named Bright Dawn.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書馬廷鸞進讀《大學衍義序》，陳心法之要。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Ma Tingluan presented a reading of the preface to the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning and set forth the essentials of the mind-method.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Ma Tingluan lectured on the preface to the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning and expounded the essentials of the cultivation of mind.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙、江東西、湖南北、廣東西、福建、成都、京西、潼川、夔、利路戶五百六十九萬六千九百八十九，口一千三百二萬六千五百三十二。

translations.literal: That year, in the circuits of Liangzhe, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, Hunan and Hubei, Guangdong and Guangxi, Fujian, Chengdu, Jingxi, Tongchuan, Kuizhou, and Lizhou, registered households numbered 5,696,989 and persons 13,026,532.
translations.idiomatic: That year the registered population in Liangzhe, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, Hunan and Hubei, Guangdong and Guangxi, Fujian, Chengdu, Jingxi, Tongchuan, Kuizhou, and Lizhou stood at 5,696,989 households and 13,026,532 persons.

sentences.zh: 大理寺奏大辟三十三人。

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review reported thirty-three capital sentences.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review reported thirty-three death sentences.

sentences.zh: 咸淳元年春正月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianchun, first month of spring, on the first day xinwei, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianchun, on the new moon xinwei in the first month of spring, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丞相賈似道請爲總護山陵使，不允，尋下詔獎諭。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Jia Sidao requested appointment as overall supervisor of the imperial mausoleum; this was not granted, but shortly thereafter an edict commended and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Jia Sidao asked to be appointed overall supervisor of the imperial mausoleum; the request was denied, but soon afterward an edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，直學士院留夢炎疏留似道。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Academician Liu Mengyan of the Hanlin Academy submitted a memorial to retain Jia Sidao.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Hanlin academician Liu Mengyan submitted a memorial urging that Jia Sidao be retained in office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諫議大夫朱貔孫等亦請改命，不報。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Remonstrance Councillor Zhu Pisun and others also requested a change of appointment; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Remonstrance Councillor Zhu Pisun and others likewise petitioned for a different appointment; the court gave no reply.

sentences.zh: 詔臨安免征商三月。

translations.literal: An edict exempted commercial taxes in Lin'an for three months.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted commercial taxes in the capital for three months.

sentences.zh: 丙子，京湖制置使呂文德辭免，不允。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Lü Wende, Commissioner for the Jing-Hu Frontier, submitted his resignation; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Lü Wende, Commissioner for the Jing-Hu Frontier, tendered his resignation; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，置籍中書，記諫官、御史言事，歲終以考成績。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengshen, a register was established at the Secretariat to record the memorials of remonstrance officials and censors, and at year's end achievements were assessed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, the Secretariat established a register recording memorials submitted by remonstrance officials and censors, with year-end review of their performance.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，似道乞解機政，不允。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou, Jia Sidao requested release from state affairs; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou, Jia Sidao asked to be relieved of state affairs; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 壬午，京湖制司創招鎮邊軍。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Jing-Hu Commission newly recruited the Frontier Garrison Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Jing-Hu Commission newly recruited a frontier garrison force.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬理宗于永穆陵。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Emperor Lizong was buried at Yongmu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Emperor Lizong was interred at Yongmu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，賞四川都統昝萬壽雲頂山、金堂峽之功，及其將士。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, Zan Wanshou, Commander-in-Chief of Sichuan, was rewarded for his achievements at Yunding Mountain and Jintang Gorge, together with his officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, Zan Wanshou, Commander-in-Chief of Sichuan, was rewarded for victories at Yunding Mountain and Jintang Gorge, along with his officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 丁未，壽崇節，免征臨安官私房僦地錢。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the Festival of Longevity and Esteem, ground-rent for official and private residences in Lin'an was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Festival of Longevity and Esteem, ground-rent on official and private residences in the capital was waived.

sentences.zh: 戊申，乾會節，如上免征，再免在京征商三月。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Festival of Qianhui, exemptions were granted as above, and commercial taxes in the capital were again waived for three months.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Festival of Qianhui, the same exemptions applied, and commercial taxes in the capital were waived for another three months.

sentences.zh: 自是祥慶、災異、寒暑皆免。

translations.literal: Thereafter, on occasions of auspicious celebration, calamities and anomalies, and extremes of cold and heat, exemptions were likewise granted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter such exemptions were routinely granted on auspicious occasions, in times of disaster or anomaly, and during extremes of heat or cold.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賈似道特授太師。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Jia Sidao was specially appointed Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Jia Sidao was specially promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸景靈宮，發米八萬石贍京城民。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the emperor visited Jingling Palace and distributed eighty thousand shi of grain to support the people of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the emperor visited Jingling Palace and released eighty thousand shi of grain to relieve the people of the capital.

sentences.zh: 夔路都統王勝以李市、沙平之戰獲功，轉官兩資，將士效力者，上其名推賞。

translations.literal: Wang Sheng, Commander-in-Chief of the Kuizhou Circuit, was rewarded for achievements in the battles of Lishi and Shaping with advancement of two ranks; officers and soldiers who had exerted themselves were to have their names submitted for recommended rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sheng, Commander-in-Chief of the Kuizhou Circuit, was advanced two ranks for victories at Lishi and Shaping, and officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves were to be named for recommended rewards.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，追命史彌遠爲公忠翊運定策元勳。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jisi, Shi Miyuan was posthumously named founding meritorious minister of loyal public service who aided the dynasty and settled the succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, Shi Miyuan was posthumously honored as a founding meritorious minister for loyal service in aiding the dynasty and securing the succession.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙巳，久雨，京城減直糶米三萬石。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on yisi, after prolonged rain, thirty thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced price in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yisi, after prolonged rains the capital sold thirty thousand shi of grain from the granaries at reduced prices.

sentences.zh: 自是米價高即發廩平糶，以爲常。

translations.literal: Thereafter, whenever the price of rice rose, the granaries were opened for equitable sale, which became the regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever grain prices rose thereafter, the state granaries released rice at stabilized prices, and this became standard policy.

sentences.zh: 丁未，發錢二十萬贍在京小民，錢二十萬賜殿、步、馬司軍人，錢二萬三千賜宿衛。

translations.literal: On dingwei, two hundred thousand strings of cash were distributed to support the common people of the capital, two hundred thousand strings were bestowed on the soldiers of the Palace, Foot, and Horse guards, and twenty-three thousand strings on the palace guards.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, two hundred thousand strings of cash were distributed to support commoners in the capital, another two hundred thousand to soldiers of the Palace, Foot, and Horse guards, and twenty-three thousand to the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 自是行慶、恤災，或遇霪雨雪寒，鹹賜如上數。

translations.literal: Thereafter, on occasions of celebration, relief for disasters, or when there was prolonged rain, snow, or cold, gifts were all granted in the amounts above.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, on festive occasions, in times of disaster relief, or during prolonged rain, snow, or cold, distributions were made in the same amounts.

sentences.zh: 以江萬里參知政事，王爚同知樞密院事、權參知政事，馬廷鸞端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Jiang Wanli was appointed Vice Grand Councillor; Wang Ye was made Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting authority as Vice Grand Councillor; Ma Tingluan was made Academician of the Duoming Hall and Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Wanli was appointed vice grand councillor; Wang Ye was made associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting authority as vice grand councillor; Ma Tingluan was appointed academician of the Duoming Hall and deputy commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以錢三十萬命臨安府通變平物賈。

translations.literal: On dingsi, three hundred thousand strings of cash were issued with orders to the Lin'an prefectural government to regulate prices and stabilize the market.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, three hundred thousand strings of cash were allocated for the Lin'an government to stabilize prices and regulate the market.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，故成都馬步軍總管張順歿于王事，詔特贈官五轉，其子與八官恩澤。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the late Zhang Shun, former Commander of the Chengdu Horse and Foot Army, died in the service of the state; an edict specially granted him five posthumous promotions, and one son was given the favor of eight official appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhang Shun, former commander of the Chengdu horse and foot forces, died in imperial service; an edict posthumously advanced him five ranks and granted one son the privilege of eight official appointments.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，名理宗御制之閣曰顯文，置學士、直學士、待制、直閣等官。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiyou, the pavilion of Emperor Lizong's imperial compositions was named Xianwen, and offices of academician, direct academician, awaiting draft, and direct pavilion attendant were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou, the pavilion housing Emperor Lizong's imperial writings was named Manifest Culture, and posts of academician, direct academician, awaiting draft, and direct pavilion attendant were established.

sentences.zh: 戊子，沿海制置使葉夢鼎三辭免，不允。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Ye Mengding, Commissioner for the Coastal Frontier, thrice submitted his resignation; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Ye Mengding, Commissioner for the Coastal Frontier, resigned three times; each request was refused.

sentences.zh: 己丑，名理宗原廟殿曰章熙。

translations.literal: On jichou, the ancestral temple hall of Emperor Lizong was named Zhangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the ancestral temple hall for Emperor Lizong was named Radiant Harmony.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 初命迪功郎鄧道爲韶州相江書院山長，主祀先儒周惇頤。

translations.literal: For the first time, Deng Dao, Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement, was appointed rector of Xiangjiang Academy in Shaozhou to preside over sacrifice to the former Confucian Zhou Dunyi.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Dao, Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement, was for the first time appointed rector of Xiangjiang Academy in Shaozhou to oversee sacrifice to the early Confucian Zhou Dunyi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，參知政事江萬里乞歸田裏，不允。

translations.literal: On renyin, Vice Grand Councillor Jiang Wanli requested to return to his home district; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Vice Grand Councillor Jiang Wanli asked to retire to his home district; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 戊申，夔路安撫徐宗武城開、達石城，乞推恩，從之。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xu Zongwu, Pacification Commissioner of the Kuizhou Circuit, walled Kai and Dashi, requested extended favors, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Xu Zongwu, Pacification Commissioner of the Kuizhou Circuit, fortified Kai and Dashi and petitioned for extended rewards; the court assented.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，督州縣嚴錢法，禁民間用牌帖。

translations.literal: On renxu, prefectures and counties were ordered to enforce the currency law strictly and to prohibit the use of private tally notes among the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, prefectures and counties were ordered to enforce currency regulations strictly and to ban private tally notes among the populace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以諒陰，命宰執類試，阮登炳以下，依廷試例出身。

translations.literal: On guihai, because of the mourning period, the chief ministers were ordered to hold a classified examination; Ruan Dengbing and those below were granted advancement according to the palace examination precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, during the mourning period, the chief ministers were ordered to hold a classified examination; Ruan Dengbing and the candidates below were advanced according to palace examination precedent.

sentences.zh: 禁在京置窠柵、私系囚。

translations.literal: The establishment of private detention wards and unauthorized imprisonment in the capital were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Private detention wards and unauthorized imprisonment in the capital were banned.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，命陳奕沿江按閱軍防，賜錢二十萬給用。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Chen Yi was ordered to inspect military defenses along the river and was granted two hundred thousand strings of cash for expenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Chen Yi was ordered to inspect riverine defenses and granted two hundred thousand strings of cash for his mission.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔有司收民田租，或掊克無藝，監司其嚴禁戢，違者有刑。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered the relevant offices to collect the people's land tax, but where there was ruthless extortion without limit, the surveillance commissioners were to prohibit and suppress it strictly, with punishment for violators.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict ordered officials to collect land tax from the people but strictly forbade ruthless over-collection; surveillance commissioners were to suppress abuses, with criminal penalties for violators.

sentences.zh: 甲午，大元元帥阿術帥大軍至廬州及安慶，諸路統制範勝、統領張林、正將高興、副將孟興逆戰，沒於陣。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Great Yuan marshal A Shu led a great army to Luzhou and Anqing; Fan Sheng, circuit commander; Zhang Lin, unit commander; Gao Xing, company commander; and Meng Xing, deputy commander, met them in battle and died in the field.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Yuan marshal A Shu led a large army against Luzhou and Anqing; Fan Sheng, Zhang Lin, Gao Xing, and Meng Xing met the invaders in battle and were killed in action.

sentences.zh: 詔勝等各官其一子進勇副尉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that one son of each of Fan Sheng and the others be appointed Vice Warden for Advancing Courage.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted one son of each man the rank of Vice Warden for Advancing Courage.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，以洪天錫爲工部侍郎兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiyou, Hong Tiansi was appointed Vice Minister of Works with concurrent service as Reader-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou, Hong Tiansi was appointed vice minister of works with concurrent duty as reader-in-attendance.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命宰執訪司馬光、蘇軾、朱熹後人，賢者能者，各上其名錄用。

translations.literal: On renzi, the chief ministers were ordered to seek out descendants of Sima Guang, Su Shi, and Zhu Xi; those who were worthy or capable were each to have their names submitted for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the chief ministers were ordered to seek descendants of Sima Guang, Su Shi, and Zhu Xi and to nominate any who proved worthy or capable for appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，呂文德言京湖制、帥、策應三司官屬，乞推恩。

translations.literal: On guichou, Lü Wende stated that the staff of the three offices of the Jing-Hu Commission, commandery headquarters, and strategic response requested extended favors.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Lü Wende petitioned for extended rewards for staff of the Jing-Hu Commission, command headquarters, and strategic response offices.

sentences.zh: 詔各進一秩。

translations.literal: An edict ordered each to advance one rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced each by one rank.

sentences.zh: 庚申，吏部侍郎李常上七事，曰崇廉恥、嚴鄉舉、擇守令、黜貪污、讞疑獄、任儒師、修役法。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Vice Minister of Personnel Li Chang submitted seven proposals: honor integrity and shame, tighten local examinations, select prefects and magistrates, dismiss the corrupt, decide doubtful cases, employ Confucian teachers, and revise the corvée law.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Vice Minister of Personnel Li Chang submitted seven reforms: promote integrity, tighten local examinations, choose capable prefects and magistrates, remove the corrupt, resolve doubtful legal cases, employ Confucian teachers, and revise corvée regulations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，減四川州縣鹽酒課，始自景定四年正月一日，再免征三年。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen, the salt and wine tax levies of Sichuan prefectures and counties were reduced, effective from the first day of the first month of the fourth year of Jingding, with a further three-year exemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen, salt and wine taxes in Sichuan prefectures and counties were reduced from the first day of the first month in the fourth year of Jingding, with a further three-year exemption.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，減田契稅錢什四。

translations.literal: On yihai, the land-deed contract tax was reduced by four-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, land-deed contract taxes were cut by forty percent.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，江安州、潼川安撫司以攻懷、簡小富砦戰圖來上，詔優答以賞。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Jiang'an Prefecture and the Tongchuan Pacification Commission submitted battle maps from the attack on Xiaofu Stockade in Huai and Jian, and an edict responded with generous commendation and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Jiang'an Prefecture and the Tongchuan Pacification Commission presented battle maps from the assault on Xiaofu Stockade in Huai and Jian; the court responded with generous praise and rewards.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，兄少保、保寧軍節度使致仕乃裕薨，贈少傅，追封臨川郡王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, Nai Yu, Elder Guard and retired Military Commissioner of the Baoning Army, died; he was posthumously made Junior Mentor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, Nai Yu — Elder Guard and retired Military Commissioner of the Baoning Army — died; he was posthumously made Junior Mentor and conferred the title Prince of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸丑，江萬里四請歸田、乞祠祿，不允，以爲湖南安撫使兼知潭州。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month of spring, on guichou, Jiang Wanli for the fourth time requested to return to his fields and begged for temple stipend; it was not granted, and he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Hunan and concurrently prefect of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on guichou in the first month of spring, Jiang Wanli for the fourth time asked to retire to his fields and sought a temple stipend; the request was denied, and he was appointed pacification commissioner of Hunan with concurrent duty as prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，侍講範東叟奏正心之要有三：曰進德，曰立政，曰事天。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yisi, Lecturer Fan Dongsou memorialized that the essentials of rectifying the heart are three: advancing virtue, establishing governance, and serving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, Lecturer Fan Dongsou memorialized that rectifying the heart rests on three essentials: advancing virtue, establishing governance, and serving Heaven.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納焉。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted the proposal.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔免湖南漕司積年運上峽米耗折逋直。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict exempted the Hunan Transport Office's accumulated years of losses, breakage, and arrears from grain transported up the gorges.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, an edict waived the Hunan Transport Office's accumulated losses and unpaid balances from years of shipping grain up the gorges.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔左、右史循舊制立侍御坐前。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered the Left and Right Historiographers to stand before the imperial seat according to the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an edict restored the old practice of having the Left and Right Historiographers stand before the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，賞夔路總管張喜等防護開、達軍功，將士進官有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengzi, Zhang Xi and others, circuit marshals of Kuizhou Circuit, were rewarded for defending Kai and Da; officers and soldiers received rank promotions in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, Zhang Xi and other circuit marshals of Kuizhou Circuit were rewarded for defending Kai and Da; officers and soldiers received promotions in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔郡守兩年爲任，方別授官。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict stated that prefects serve two-year terms before being reassigned to different offices.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict fixed prefectural terms at two years before reassignment to other posts.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜敕書獎諭呂文德。

translations.literal: On wushen, an imperial letter was granted to commend Lü Wende.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an imperial letter of commendation was sent to Lü Wende.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，洪天錫三請祠，不允，以顯文閣待制知潭州兼湖南安撫使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou, Hong Tiansi for the third time requested a temple appointment; it was not granted, and he was made Awaiting Draftsman of the Xianwen Pavilion, prefect of Tanzhou, and concurrently Pacification Commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou, Hong Tiansi for the third time sought a temple appointment; the request was denied, and he was appointed awaiting draftsman of the Xianwen Pavilion, prefect of Tanzhou, and concurrently pacification commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，侍御史程元岳上言：「帝王致壽之道在修德，後世怵邪說以求之，往轍可鑒。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Censor Cheng Yuanyue submitted: "The way for emperors to attain longevity lies in cultivating virtue; later ages, swayed by heterodox teachings, seek it elsewhere — the tracks of the past may serve as a mirror."
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Censor Cheng Yuanyue submitted that the path to longevity for emperors lies in cultivating virtue, whereas later ages, misled by heterodox teachings, seek it by other means — the precedents of the past stand as a warning.

sentences.zh: 修德之目有三，曰清心，曰寡欲，曰崇儉，皆致壽之原。

translations.literal: The categories of cultivating virtue are three: purifying the heart, limiting desires, and honoring frugality — all are the roots of attaining longevity.
translations.idiomatic: The categories of cultivating virtue are three: purifying the heart, limiting desires, and honoring frugality — each a foundation of longevity.

sentences.zh: 」上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted the memorial.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，授信州布衣徐直方史館編校。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Xu Zhifang, a commoner of Xinzhou, was appointed Compiler-Proofreader of the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Xu Zhifang, a commoner of Xinzhou, was appointed compiler-proofreader of the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，詔諸節制將帥討軍實，節浮費，毋占役兵士，致妨訓練。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guichou, an edict ordered all commanders and generals with jurisdictional authority to audit military strength, curtail wasteful spending, and not requisition soldiers for other duties so as not to hinder training.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guichou, an edict directed all jurisdictional commanders to audit troop strength, cut wasteful spending, and cease requisitioning soldiers for other duties so training would not suffer.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，給羅鬼國化州印。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingchou, the seal of Huazhou was issued to the Luogui Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingchou, the seal of Huazhou was granted to the Luogui Kingdom.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以衢州饑，命守、令勸分諸藩邸發廩助之。

translations.literal: On renwu, because Quzhou suffered famine, the prefect and magistrates were ordered to urge the various princely residences to open their granaries and share aid.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, because Quzhou was stricken by famine, the prefect and magistrates were ordered to urge the princely residences to open their granaries and share relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，祈雨，詔以來年正月一日郊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, rain was prayed for, and an edict fixed the suburban sacrifice for the first day of the first month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, prayers for rain were offered, and an edict set the suburban sacrifice for the first day of the first month of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禮部侍郎李伯玉言：「人材貴乎善養，不貴速成，請罷童子科，息奔競，以保幼稚良心。

translations.literal: On renyin, Vice Minister of Rites Li Boyu stated: "Talent is worth nurturing properly, not rushing to completion; I request abolishing the Youth Examination, quieting the scramble for advancement, and preserving the innocent conscience of children."
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Vice Minister of Rites Li Boyu stated that talent is best nurtured slowly rather than rushed to completion, and requested abolishing the Youth Examination to quiet the scramble for advancement and preserve the innocent conscience of children.

sentences.zh: 」詔自咸淳三年爲始罷之。

translations.literal: An edict abolished it starting from the third year of Xianchun.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished the examination beginning in the third year of Xianchun.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，安南國遣使賀登位，獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiashen, Annam sent envoys to congratulate the accession to the throne and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, Annam sent envoys to congratulate the new emperor's accession and presented tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，浙西安撫使李芾以台臣黃萬石等言，削兩秩免。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingchen, Li Fei, Pacification Commissioner of Western Zhejiang, was demoted two ranks and dismissed on the statement of censorial officials Huang Wanshi and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, Li Fei, pacification commissioner of Western Zhejiang, was demoted two ranks and dismissed on the petition of censorial officials including Huang Wanshi.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛丑，兩淮制置使李庭芝立城，屯駐武銳一軍，以工役費用及圖來上。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinchou, Li Tingzhi, Commissioner for the Two Huai Circuits, built a city and stationed the Wurui First Army, submitting reports on labor costs and maps.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinchou, Li Tingzhi, commissioner for the Two Huai circuits, built a fortified city and stationed the Wurui First Army, submitting reports on labor costs and construction maps.

sentences.zh: 詔獎勞之。

translations.literal: An edict commended and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，少師致仕趙葵薨，贈太傅，賜諡忠靖。

translations.literal: On yimao, Zhao Kui, Junior Preceptor, retired, died; he was posthumously made Grand Mentor and granted the posthumous title Loyal and Tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zhao Kui, retired junior preceptor, died; he was posthumously made grand mentor and granted the posthumous title Zhongjing.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，利東安撫使、知合州張玨調統制史炤、監軍王世昌等復廣安大樑城，詔推爵賞有差。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Zhang Jue, Eastern Sichuan Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Hezhou, mobilized Commander Shi Zhao, Supervising General Wang Shichang, and others to recover Guang'an Daliang City; an edict granted rank and rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Zhang Jue, eastern Sichuan pacification commissioner and prefect of Hezhou, mobilized Commander Shi Zhao, Supervising General Wang Shichang, and others to recover Guang'an Daliang City; an edict granted ranks and rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，申嚴戢貪之令。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingchou, the decree to restrain corruption was sternly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingchou, the decree against corruption was sternly enforced.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以請先帝諡祭告天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On jiashen, offerings were made to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain to request the posthumous title for the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, offerings were made to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain to seek the late emperor's posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，奉冊寶請於南郊，上諡曰建道備德大功復興烈文仁武聖明安孝皇帝，廟號理宗。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the regalia were presented at the southern suburb with a request; the posthumous title given was Emperor Jiandao Beide Dagong Fuxing Liewen Renwu Shengming Anxiao, and the temple name was Lizong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the regalia were presented at the southern suburb; the late emperor was posthumously titled Emperor Jiandao Beide Dagong Fuxing Liewen Renwu Shengming Anxiao, with the temple name Lizong.

sentences.zh: 大理寺奏歲終大辟古十五人。

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review reported that at year's end fifteen persons had been sentenced to capital punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review reported that fifteen persons had been sentenced to death by year's end.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己丑朔，郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month of spring, on jichou the new moon day, the suburban sacrifice was performed and a general amnesty was declared.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on jichou the new moon day in the first month of spring, the suburban sacrifice was performed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，奉皇太后寶，上尊號曰壽和。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the empress dowager's seal was presented, and the honorific title Shouhe was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the empress dowager's seal was presented and the honorific title Shouhe was conferred.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，壽和太后冊、寶禮成，謝堂等二十七人各進一秩，高平郡夫人謝氏等二十二人各進封、特封有差。

translations.literal: On xinchou, upon completion of the regalia ceremony for Empress Dowager Shouhe, Xie Tang and twenty-seven others each advanced one rank; Ladies of Gaoping Commandery Madame Xie and twenty-two others received varying promotions and special enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, after the regalia ceremony for Empress Dowager Shouhe was completed, Xie Tang and twenty-seven others each advanced one rank; Madame Xie, Lady of Gaoping Commandery, and twenty-two others received promotions and special enfeoffments in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，冊命妃全氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: On guimao, Consort Quan was invested by decree as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Consort Quan was invested as empress by decree.

sentences.zh: 戊申，帝詣太學謁孔子，行舍菜禮，以顏淵、曾參、孔伋、孟軻配享，顓孫師升十哲，邵雍、司馬光升列從祀，雍封新安伯。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy to pay respects to Confucius and performed the vegetable-offering rite; Yan Yuan, Zeng Shen, Kong Ji, and Meng Ke were matched in sacrifice; Zhuansun Shi was promoted to the Ten Sages; Shao Yong and Sima Guang were promoted to associate sacrifice; Yong was enfeoffed as Earl of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy to pay respects to Confucius and performed the vegetable-offering rite; Yan Yuan, Zeng Shen, Kong Ji, and Meng Ke were accorded matched sacrifice; Zhuansun Shi was elevated among the Ten Sages; Shao Yong and Sima Guang were elevated to associate sacrifice; and Shao Yong was enfeoffed as Earl of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書陳宗禮、國子祭酒陳宜中進讀《中庸》。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Chen Zongli and Director of the Directorate of Education Chen Yizhong lectured on the Doctrine of the Mean.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Chen Zongli and Director of the Directorate of Education Chen Yizhong lectured on the Doctrine of the Mean.

sentences.zh: 己酉，執經官宗禮、講經官宜中各進一秩，宜中賜紫章服。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Zongli as scripture lecturer and Yizhong as lecture-official each advanced one rank; Yizhong was granted purple official robes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zongli as scripture lecturer and Yizhong as lecture-official each advanced one rank; Yizhong was granted purple official robes.

sentences.zh: 太學、武學、宗學、國子學、宗正寺官若醫官、監書庫、門、庖等，各進一秩，諸齋長諭及起居學生推恩有差。

translations.literal: Officials of the Imperial Academy, Military Academy, Princely Academy, Directorate of Education, Court of the Imperial Clan, medical officers, book-depot supervisors, gatekeepers, kitchen staff, and others each advanced one rank; head tutors of the various halls and resident students received favor in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Imperial Academy, Military Academy, Princely Academy, Directorate of Education, Court of the Imperial Clan, medical officers, book-depot supervisors, gatekeepers, kitchen staff, and others each advanced one rank; head tutors of the various halls and resident students received rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，壽和太后親屬謝奕修、郭自中、黃興在等二十八人各升補一秩。

translations.literal: On yimao, twenty-eight relatives of Empress Dowager Shouhe including Xie Yixiu, Guo Zizhong, and Huang Xingzai each received promotion by one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, twenty-eight relatives of Empress Dowager Shouhe, including Xie Yixiu, Guo Zizhong, and Huang Xingzai, each advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，克復廣安軍，詔改爲寧西軍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiwei, Guang'an Army was recovered; an edict changed its name to Ningxi Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiwei, Guang'an Army was recovered, and an edict renamed it Ningxi Army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，馬光祖再乞致仕，不允。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Ma Guangzu again requested retirement; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Ma Guangzu again requested retirement; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔賈似道太師、平章軍國重事，一月三赴經筵，三日一朝，治事都堂。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict made Jia Sidao Grand Preceptor and Director of State Affairs, to attend the Classics Lectern three times a month, appear at court every three days, and conduct affairs at the chief council hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict appointed Jia Sidao grand preceptor and director of state affairs, requiring him to attend the Classics Lectern three times a month, appear at court every three days, and conduct affairs at the chief council hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，樞密院言：知夔州、夔路安撫徐宗武創立臥龍山堡囿。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported that Xu Zongwu, prefect of Kuizhou and Pacification Commissioner of Kuizhou Circuit, had established Wulongshan Fortified Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported that Xu Zongwu, prefect of Kuizhou and pacification commissioner of Kuizhou Circuit, had established the Wulongshan fortified enclosure.

sentences.zh: 詔宗武帶行遙郡團練使，以旌其勞。

translations.literal: An edict granted Zongwu acting distant-prefecture regimental commander to honor his labors.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Zongwu the acting title of distant-prefecture regimental commander to honor his labors.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，知房州李鑒及將校杜汝隆、夏喜以戰龍光砦有功，優與旌賞。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guimao, Li Jian, prefect of Fangzhou, and officers Du Rulong and Xia Xi were generously commended and rewarded for fighting at Longguang Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, Li Jian, prefect of Fangzhou, and the officers Du Rulong and Xia Xi were generously commended and rewarded for their victory at Longguang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，壽和太后兩次冊、寶，族兄弟謝奕實等十五人、族侄謝在達等四十七人、族侄孫謝鏞等十四人各錫銀十兩、帛十匹。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen, upon the second regalia ceremony for Empress Dowager Shouhe, fifteen clansmen-brothers including Xie Yishi, forty-seven clansmen-nephews including Xie Zaida, and fourteen clansmen-great-nephews including Xie Yong each received ten taels of silver and ten bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen, at the second regalia ceremony for Empress Dowager Shouhe, fifteen clansmen-brothers including Xie Yishi, forty-seven clansmen-nephews including Xie Zaida, and fourteen clansmen-great-nephews including Xie Yong each received ten taels of silver and ten bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 詔：太中大夫全清夫儒科發身，懇陳換班，靖退可尚，特授清遠軍承宣使、提舉佑神觀，仍奉朝請。

translations.literal: An edict stated: Quan Qingfu, Grand Master of Palace Attendance, who rose through the Confucian examination track, earnestly requested transfer to a military appointment; his quiet retirement was admirable; he was specially appointed Commissioner-in-Chief of the Qingyuan Army and Director of the Youshen View, while retaining attendance at court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that Quan Qingfu, grand master of palace attendance, who had risen through the Confucian examination track, earnestly sought transfer to a military appointment; his modest wish to withdraw was deemed admirable, and he was specially appointed commissioner-in-chief of the Qingyuan Army and director of the Youshen View, while retaining attendance at court.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，張玨護合州春耕，戰款龍溪，以狀言功，詔趣上立功將士姓名。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Zhang Jue supervised spring plowing in Hezhou and fought at Kuanlong Creek; he submitted a report stating his merit, and an edict urged submission of the names of officers and soldiers who had achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhang Jue supervised spring plowing in Hezhou and fought at Kuanlong Creek; he submitted a report of his achievements, and an edict ordered prompt submission of the names of meritorious officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day dinghai, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon dinghai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「比常命有司按月給百官奉，惟官愈卑，去民愈親，仍聞過期弗予，是吏奉吾命不虔也，諸路監司其嚴糾劾。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict stated: "We have customarily ordered the responsible offices to pay officials their salaries month by month; yet the lower the rank, the closer to the people, and we still hear that payment is overdue and not given. This means the clerks carry out our orders without diligence. Supervisory officials of all circuits must strictly investigate and impeach."
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an edict declared: "It has been our standing practice to have the responsible offices pay officials their salaries each month. The lower their rank, the closer they are to the people — yet we still hear of salaries withheld past due. That shows the clerks are not carrying out our orders with proper care. Supervisory officials in every circuit must investigate and impeach offenders strictly."

sentences.zh: 」六月壬戌，加授呂文德少傅，馬光祖參知政事，李庭芝兵部尚書，並職任仍舊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renxu, Lü Wende was additionally invested as Junior Tutor, Ma Guangzu as Vice Grand Councillor, and Li Tingzhi as Minister of War, while their duties all remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renxu, Lü Wende was further appointed Junior Tutor, Ma Guangzu Vice Grand Councillor, and Li Tingzhi Minister of War; each retained his existing responsibilities.

sentences.zh: 皇后受冊推恩，弟全清夫以下十五人官一轉，全必槱以下十七人補承信郎。

translations.literal: When the empress received her investiture, favors were extended: the empress's younger brother Quan Qingfu and fourteen others below him were promoted one rank, and Quan Biyun and sixteen others below him were appointed Chengxin Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the empress's investiture, favors were extended: her younger brother Quan Qingfu and fourteen others below him each advanced one rank, while Quan Biyun and sixteen others below him were appointed Chengxin Lang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，美人楊氏進封淑妃。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Lady Yang the Meiren was advanced to Shufei.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Lady Yang the Meiren was promoted to Imperial Consort of Cultivated Demeanor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔榮王族姻與萊等三十四人各轉官有差。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict ordered that relatives by marriage of the Prince of Rong, Yu Lai, and thirty-two others received promotions of varying degree.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, an edict granted relatives by marriage of the Prince of Rong, Yu Lai, and thirty-two others promotions of varying degree.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，張玨授正任團練使、帶行左領軍衛大將軍，賜金帶。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dinghai, Zhang Jue was appointed regular regimental commander and Acting Left Commandant of the Leading Army Guard, and was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dinghai, Zhang Jue was appointed regular regimental commander and Acting Left Commandant of the Leading Army Guard, and received a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，樞密院言：「右武大夫、權鄂州都統汪政鄂城戰禦，又焚光化城外積聚，及攻真陽城，皆有功，該轉十二官。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Right Military Grand Master and acting Ezhou commander-in-chief Wang Zheng fought in defense at Echeng, also burned stockpiles outside Guanghua, and attacked Zhenyang — all with merit; he warrants promotion by twelve ranks."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Right Military Grand Master and acting commander-in-chief of Ezhou Wang Zheng defended Echeng in battle, burned stockpiles outside Guanghua, and attacked Zhenyang — all meritorious service warranting promotion by twelve ranks."

sentences.zh: 」詔轉橫行遙郡。

translations.literal: An edict ordered promotion along the crosswise remote-prefecture track.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered his promotion along the crosswise remote-prefecture track.

sentences.zh: 甲午，四川都統昝萬壽調統制趙寶、楊立等率舟師護糧達渠城，以功推賞。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Sichuan commander-in-chief Zan Wanshou dispatched regimental commanders Zhao Bao, Yang Li, and others to lead a fleet escorting grain to Qucheng; rewards were granted according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Sichuan commander-in-chief Zan Wanshou dispatched regimental commanders Zhao Bao, Yang Li, and others to lead a fleet escorting grain to Qucheng, and they were rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 己酉，權黎州張午招諭大青羌主歸義，乞用兩林西蕃瑜林例，賜予加優，從之。

translations.literal: On jiyou, acting Prefect of Lizhou Zhang Wu persuaded the chieftain of the Daqing Qiang to submit in allegiance; he requested that the precedent of Yulin of the Lianglin Western tribes be applied, with enhanced rewards; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, acting Prefect of Lizhou Zhang Wu persuaded the chieftain of the Daqing Qiang to submit in allegiance and asked that the precedent of Yulin of the Lianglin Western tribes be applied with enhanced rewards; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，遣步帥陳奕率馬軍舟師巡邏江防。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinyou, the infantry commander Chen Yi was dispatched to lead cavalry and naval forces in patrolling the river defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinyou, infantry commander Chen Yi was dispatched to lead cavalry and naval forces in patrolling the river defenses.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，邊報警急，詔諭呂文德等申嚴防遏。

translations.literal: On renxu, frontier reports were urgently alarming; an edict instructed Lü Wende and others to strictly enforce defense and interdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, urgent alarms arrived from the frontier; an edict instructed Lü Wende and others to tighten defenses and interdiction.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太師、武康、寧江軍節度使、判大宗正事嗣榮王與芮進封福王，主榮王祀事。

translations.literal: On yichou, Grand Preceptor, Military Commissioner of the Wukang and Ningjiang armies, and Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court Zhao Yourui, Succeeding Prince of Rong, was advanced to Prince of Fu and charged with presiding over the sacrifices of the Prince of Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Grand Preceptor, Military Commissioner of the Wukang and Ningjiang armies, and Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court Zhao Yourui, Succeeding Prince of Rong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Fu and charged with presiding over the sacrifices of the Prince of Rong.

sentences.zh: 壬申，久雨，命在京三獄、赤縣、直司、簽廳擇官審決獄訟毋滯。

translations.literal: On renshen, after prolonged rain, officials were selected in the capital's three prisons, directly administered prefectures, direct agencies, and petition offices to try and decide cases without delay.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, after prolonged rain, officials were selected from the capital's three prisons, directly administered prefectures, direct agencies, and petition offices to try cases without delay.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，詔郡縣折收民田租，毋厚直取贏，違者論罪。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yiwei, an edict ordered prefectures and counties to collect land rent from the people at assessed rates and not take excess profit; violators were to be prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiwei, an edict ordered prefectures and counties to collect land rent at assessed rates and not take excess profit; violators would be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，知邕州總統譚淵、李旺、周勝等繇特磨行大理界，率兵攻建水州，禽其知州阿孱以下三百餘人，獲馬二百余，焚谷米、器甲、廬舍。

translations.literal: On guimao, overall commander of Yongzhou Tan Yuan, Li Wang, Zhou Sheng, and others, traveling via Temo into Dali territory, led troops to attack Jianshui Prefecture, captured its prefect A Chan and more than three hundred others below him, seized more than two hundred horses, and burned grain, armor, and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, overall commander of Yongzhou Tan Yuan, Li Wang, Zhou Sheng, and others entered Dali territory via Temo, led troops to attack Jianshui Prefecture, captured its prefect A Chan and more than three hundred subordinates, seized more than two hundred horses, and burned grain, armor, and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 師還論功，各轉官三資，軍校補轉有差。

translations.literal: When the army returned, merits were assessed: each was promoted three ranks, and military officers received promotions of varying degree.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, merits were assessed: each man was promoted three ranks, and military officers received promotions of varying degree.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，復開州，賜四川策應司錢百萬勞軍。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengshen, Kaizhou was recovered; one million cash from the Sichuan Support Bureau was granted to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on gengshen, Kaizhou was recovered, and one million cash from the Sichuan Support Bureau was granted to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大雷電。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, there was great thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, there was violent thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，故左丞相吳潛追復光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, the former Left Grand Councillor Wu Qian was posthumously restored to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, the former Left Grand Councillor Wu Qian was posthumously restored to the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賞知房州李鑒調遣路將夏喜、統領馮興等均州武陽壩戰功。

translations.literal: On renyin, Prefect of Fangzhou Li Jian was rewarded for dispatching route generals Xia Xi and commander Feng Xing and others for their battle merits at Wuyang Dam in Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Prefect of Fangzhou Li Jian was rewarded for dispatching route generals Xia Xi and commander Feng Xing and others for their battle merits at Wuyang Dam in Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，呂文煥依舊帶行御器械，改知襄陽府兼京西安撫副使，丁卯，台臣言敘復元官觀文殿學士、提舉洞霄宮皮龍榮貪私傾險，嘗朋附丁大全，乞寢新命。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, Lü Wenhuán continued as Acting Commissioner of the Imperial Armory and was transferred to Prefect of Xiangyang and Vice Commissioner of Jingxi Pacification. On dingmao, censorial officials reported that the restored former Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Supervisor of the Dongxiao Palace Pi Longrong was greedy, scheming, and had once attached himself to Ding Daquan; they requested that the new appointment be revoked.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, Lü Wenhuán continued as Acting Commissioner of the Imperial Armory and was transferred to Prefect of Xiangyang and Vice Commissioner of Jingxi Pacification. On dingmao, censorial officials reported that the restored former Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Supervisor of the Dongxiao Palace Pi Longrong was greedy and scheming and had once attached himself to Ding Daquan; they asked that his new appointment be revoked.

sentences.zh: 詔予祠祿。

translations.literal: An edict granted him a temple stipend.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him a temple stipend.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸未，賜呂師夔紫章服、金帶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month of spring, on guiwei, Lü Shikao was granted purple official robes and a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month of spring, on guiwei, Lü Shikao was granted purple official robes and a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 己丑，呂文德言知襄陽府兼京西安撫副使呂文煥、荊鄂都統制唐永堅蠟書報白河口、萬山、鹿門山北帥興築城堡，檄知郢州翟貴、兩淮都統張世傑申嚴備禦。

translations.literal: On jichou, Lü Wende reported that Prefect of Xiangyang and Vice Commissioner of Jingxi Pacification Lü Wenhuán and Jing-E commander-in-chief Tang Yongjian had sent wax-sealed dispatches reporting that northern commanders were building fortifications at Baihekou, Wanshan, and Lumen Mountain; orders were sent to Prefect of Yingzhou Zhai Gui and Two-Huai commander-in-chief Zhang Shijie to strictly prepare defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Lü Wende reported that Prefect of Xiangyang and Vice Commissioner of Jingxi Pacification Lü Wenhuán and Jing-E commander-in-chief Tang Yongjian had sent wax-sealed dispatches reporting that northern commanders were building fortifications at Baihekou, Wanshan, and Lumen Mountain; orders were sent to Prefect of Yingzhou Zhai Gui and Two-Huai commander-in-chief Zhang Shijie to tighten defenses.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，故守合州王堅賜廟額曰「報忠」。

translations.literal: On guisi, the former defender of Hezhou Wang Jian was granted a temple inscription reading "Repaying Loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the former defender of Hezhou Wang Jian was granted a temple inscription reading "Repaying Loyalty."

sentences.zh: 癸卯，沔州駐紮、潼川安撫副使昝萬壽特升右武大夫、帶行左驍衛大將軍，賜金帶。

translations.literal: On guimao, garrison commander at Mianzhou and Vice Commissioner of Tongchuan Pacification Zan Wanshou was specially promoted to Right Military Grand Master and Acting Left General of the Valiant Cavalry Guard, and was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, garrison commander at Mianzhou and Vice Commissioner of Tongchuan Pacification Zan Wanshou was specially promoted to Right Military Grand Master and Acting Left General of the Valiant Cavalry Guard, and received a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 己酉，印應雷改知慶元府兼沿海制置使。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Yin Yinglei was transferred to Prefect of Qingyuan and Coastal Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Yin Yinglei was transferred to Prefect of Qingyuan and Coastal Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔曰：「邇年近臣無謂引去以爲高，勉留再三，弗近益遠，往往相尚，不知其非義也。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict stated: "In recent years court ministers have pointlessly taken leave to affect loftiness; though repeatedly urged to stay, the more urged the farther they go, each emulating the other, unaware that this is wrong."
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, an edict declared: "In recent years court ministers have pointlessly taken leave to affect loftiness; though repeatedly urged to stay, the more they are urged the farther they go, each emulating the other, unaware that this is wrong."

sentences.zh: 亦由一二大臣嘗勇去以爲衆望，相踵至今。

translations.literal: This also stems from one or two grand ministers who once boldly resigned to win public esteem, and others have followed ever since.
translations.idiomatic: This also stems from one or two grand ministers who once boldly resigned to win public esteem, and others have followed ever since.

sentences.zh: 孟子于齊王不遇，故去，是未嘗有君臣之情也，然猶三宿出晝，庶幾改之。

translations.literal: When Mencius did not meet with approval from King Xuan of Qi, he therefore left — there had never been any bond between lord and minister — yet he still spent three nights at Zhou before departing, hoping the king might reform.
translations.idiomatic: When Mencius did not meet with approval from King Xuan of Qi, he therefore left — there had never been any bond between lord and minister — yet he still spent three nights at Zhou before departing, hoping the king might reform.

sentences.zh: 儒者家法，無亦取此乎。

translations.literal: Should not the house rules of the Confucians take this as their model?
translations.idiomatic: Should not the house rules of the Confucians take this as their model?

sentences.zh: 朕于諸賢，允謂無負，其弗高尚，使人疑於負朕。

translations.literal: We toward you worthies can truly say we owe nothing; if you will not hold yourselves aloof, it will make people suspect that we have failed you.
translations.idiomatic: Toward you worthies We can truly say We owe nothing; if you will not hold yourselves aloof, it will make people suspect that We have failed you.

sentences.zh: 」閏月庚午，賜夏貴金帶。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengwu, Xia Gui was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengwu, Xia Gui was granted a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，湯漢三辭免刑部侍郎、福建安撫使。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renwu, Tang Han thrice requested removal from the posts of Vice Minister of Justice and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on renwu, Tang Han thrice requested removal from the posts of Vice Minister of Justice and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，乾會節，帝御紫宸殿，群臣稱賀。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Ganhui Festival, the Emperor attended the Purple Reach Hall, and the ministers offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Ganhui Festival, the Emperor attended the Purple Reach Hall, and the ministers offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「謝方叔託名進香，擅進金器諸物，且以先帝手澤，每系之跋，率多包藏，至以先帝行事爲己功，殊失大臣體，宜鐫一秩。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Xie Fangshu used incense offering as a pretext, presumptuously presenting gold vessels and other objects; moreover, with the late emperor's autograph writings, he attached colophons to each — most of them quite insinuating — even claiming the late emperor's deeds as his own merit. This gravely falls short of a grand minister's bearing; one rank should be cut."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Xie Fangshu used incense offering as a pretext, presumptuously presenting gold vessels and other objects; moreover, with the late emperor's autograph writings, he attached colophons to each — most of them quite insinuating — even claiming the late emperor's deeds as his own merit. This gravely falls short of a grand minister's bearing; one rank should be cut."

sentences.zh: 」於是盧鉞等相繼論列方叔昨蜀、廣敗事，誤國殄民，今又違制擅進，削一秩罰輕。

translations.literal: Thereupon Lu Yue and others successively impeached Fangshu for past failures in Shu and Guang that harmed the state and destroyed the people; now again violating regulations with unauthorized offerings — cutting one rank was too light a penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Lu Yue and others successively impeached Fangshu for past failures in Shu and Guang that harmed the state and destroyed the people; now again violating regulations with unauthorized offerings — cutting one rank was too light a penalty.

sentences.zh: 詔削四秩，奪觀文殿大學士、惠國公，罷宰臣恩數，仍追《寶奎錄》並系跋真本來上。

translations.literal: An edict cut four ranks, stripped him of Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Duke of Huiguo, revoked grand councillor perquisites, and ordered the original Baokui Record and attached colophons sent up.
translations.idiomatic: An edict cut four ranks, stripped him of Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Duke of Huiguo, revoked grand councillor perquisites, and ordered the original Baokui Record and attached colophons sent up.

sentences.zh: 丙申，右正言黃鏞言：「今守邊急務，非兵農合一不可。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Right Remonstrator Huang Yong said: "The urgent task of border defense cannot be accomplished without uniting military and agricultural affairs."
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Right Remonstrator Huang Yong said: "The urgent task of border defense cannot be accomplished without uniting military and agricultural affairs."

sentences.zh: 一曰屯田，二曰民兵。

translations.literal: The first is military colonies; the second is militia.
translations.idiomatic: The first is military colonies; the second is militia.

sentences.zh: 川蜀屯田爲先，民兵次之，淮、襄民兵爲先，屯田次之，此足食足兵良策也。

translations.literal: In Chuan-Shu, military colonies come first and militia second; in Huai and Xiang, militia come first and colonies second — this is an excellent policy for sufficient food and troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Chuan-Shu, military colonies should come first and militia second; in Huai and Xiang, militia should come first and colonies second — this is an excellent policy for sufficient food and troops.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: No response was given.
translations.idiomatic: No response was given.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔故修武郎姚濟死節，立廟，賜額曰「忠壯」。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict stated that the former Xiuxu Lang Yao Ji died a martyr's death; a temple was established, and an inscription was granted reading "Loyal and Stalwart."
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, an edict stated that the former Xiuxu Lang Yao Ji died a martyr's death; a temple was established, and an inscription was granted reading "Loyal and Stalwart."

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，樞密都承旨高達再辭侍衛都虞候，乞歸田裏，命孫虎臣代之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinyou, Chief Coordinator of the Bureau of Military Affairs Gao Da again declined the post of Commandant of the Palace Guard and requested retirement to his fields; Sun Huchen was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinyou, Chief Coordinator of the Bureau of Military Affairs Gao Da again declined the post of Commandant of the Palace Guard and requested retirement to his fields; Sun Huchen was ordered to replace him.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜陳文龍以下六百六十四人進士及第、出身。

translations.literal: On renshen, six hundred sixty-four persons including Chen Wenlong were granted jinshi with honors or jinshi by decree.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, six hundred sixty-four persons including Chen Wenlong were granted jinshi with honors or jinshi by decree.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賈似道乞骸骨，不允。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Jia Sidao requested retirement; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Jia Sidao requested retirement; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，葉夢鼎再乞歸田裏，不允。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinsi, Ye Mengding again requested return to his fields; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi, Ye Mengding again requested return to his fields; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 詔罷浙西諸州公田莊官，募民自耕輸租，租減什三，毋私相易田，違制以盜賣官田論。

translations.literal: An edict abolished the public land estate officials in the Zhexi prefectures, recruited commoners to farm and pay rent themselves, reduced rent by three-tenths, forbade private exchange of land, and ordered that violators be prosecuted as for illegal sale of government land.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished the public land estate officials in the Zhexi prefectures, recruited commoners to farm and pay rent themselves, reduced rent by three-tenths, forbade private exchange of land, and ordered that violators be prosecuted as for illegal sale of government land.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，有星出氐宿，西北急流入騎官星沒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuwu, a star appeared at the Di lodge, flowing rapidly northwest into the Cavalry Official star and disappearing.
