translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuwu, a star appeared at the Di constellation, streaked swiftly northwest into the Cavalry Official star, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 己未，淑妃楊氏親屬楊幼節以下百三十四人推恩進秩。

translations.literal: On jiwei, one hundred thirty-four persons including Yang Youjie, a kinsman of the Virtuous Consort Lady Yang, were promoted by grace in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, one hundred thirty-four kinsmen of the Virtuous Consort Lady Yang, beginning with Yang Youjie, received promotions by imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，奉安《寧宗實錄》、《理宗實錄》、《御集》、《日曆》、《會要》、《玉牒》、《經武要略》、《咸淳日曆》、《玉牒》，賈似道、葉夢鼎、馬廷鸞各補轉兩官，諸局官若吏推恩有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renyin, the Veritable Records of Ningzong, the Veritable Records of Lizong, the Imperial Collectanea, the Daily Calendar, the Institutional Compendium, the Jade Register, the Essential Military Compendium, the Xianchun Daily Calendar, and the Jade Register were ceremonially installed; Jia Sidao, Ye Mengding, and Ma Tingluan each received two additional rank promotions; officials and clerks of the various bureaus received grace promotions in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, the court ceremonially installed the Veritable Records of Ningzong and Lizong, the Imperial Collectanea, the Daily Calendar, the Institutional Compendium, the Jade Register, the Essential Military Compendium, and the Xianchun Daily Calendar; Jia Sidao, Ye Mengding, and Ma Tingluan were each promoted two ranks; and clerks and officials of the relevant bureaus received grace promotions in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guiwei, Venus appeared in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 大元兵築白河城，始圍襄、樊。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops built White River Fort and began besieging Xiangyang and Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan troops built White River Fort and began the siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day of the month, wuyin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 子憲生。

translations.literal: The son Xian was born.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xian was born.

sentences.zh: 參知政事常挺六乞歸田裏，詔予郡。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councillor Chang Ting six times requested to return to his home fields; an edict granted him a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councillor Chang Ting six times requested retirement to his home district; the emperor granted him a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，已減四川州縣鹽酒課，詔自咸淳四年始，再免征三年。

translations.literal: On jihai, since the salt and wine levies of Sichuan prefectures and counties had already been reduced, an edict ordered that from the fourth year of Xianchun they be exempted again for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, an edict declared that since Sichuan's prefectural and county salt and wine levies had already been reduced, they would be exempted anew for three years beginning in the fourth year of Xianchun.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，樞密院言：「南平、紹慶六郡鎮撫使韓宣城渝、嘉、開、達、常、武諸州有勞，繇峽州至江陵水陸措置，盡瘁以死，宜視沒于王事加恩。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guichou, the Bureau of Military Affairs stated: "Han Xuan, Pacification Commissioner of the six prefectures of Nanping and Shaoqing, rendered service fortifying Yu, Jia, Kai, Da, Chang, and Wu prefectures; from Xia Prefecture to Jiangling he made arrangements by land and water, exerting himself unto death — grace should be extended as for one who died in service of the state."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Han Xuan, pacification commissioner of the six prefectures of Nanping and Shaoqing, had distinguished himself fortifying Yu, Jia, Kai, Da, Chang, and Wu; from Xia Prefecture to Jiangling he coordinated land and water transport until he died from overwork — he should receive the honors granted to one who perished in the service of the state."

sentences.zh: 」詔宣守本官致仕，任一子承節郎，仍贈正任承宣使。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Han to retire while retaining his present rank, granted one son the post of Gentleman for Attending Duty, and posthumously conferred the regular rank of Commissioner for Propagation of Grace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted Han to retire at his present rank, appointed one son Gentleman for Attending Duty, and posthumously conferred on him the rank of Commissioner for Propagation of Grace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔知江陵府陳奕，裨將周全、王德等戰西山、南谷口、田家山有功，各以等第推賞。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict rewarded Chen Yi, Prefect of Jiangling, and the lieutenant generals Zhou Quan, Wang De, and others for merit in battle at Xishan, Nangukou, and Tianjiashan, each according to grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, an edict awarded Chen Yi, prefect of Jiangling, and his lieutenant generals Zhou Quan, Wang De, and others graded rewards for their victories at Xishan, Nangukou, and Tianjiashan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，子鍠生。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the son Huang was born.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Prince Huang was born.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，福建安撫使湯漢再辭免，乞祠祿，詔別授職。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Fujian Pacification Commissioner Tang Han again requested removal and sought a stipend post; an edict assigned him another office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Fujian Pacification Commissioner Tang Han again requested dismissal and sought a stipendary post; an edict assigned him to another office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以文武官在選，困於部吏，隆寒旅瑣可閔。

translations.literal: On xinwei, because civil and military officials awaiting selection were afflicted by the ministry clerks, their distress in the bitter cold amid petty travel formalities was pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the court noted that civil and military officials awaiting appointment were at the mercy of ministry clerks, suffering pitiably through bitter cold and petty travel formalities.

sentences.zh: 詔吏部長貳、郎官日趣銓注，小有未備，特與放行，違者有刑。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the senior and junior officials of the Ministry of Personnel and the department directors to press daily for registry appointments; if minor matters were incomplete, they were specially to be released anyway — violators would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Personnel's senior and junior officials and departmental directors to expedite appointments daily; even when minor paperwork was incomplete, candidates were to be released forthwith — violators would face punishment.

sentences.zh: 自是隆寒盛暑，申嚴誡飭。

translations.literal: From this time on, during bitter cold and sweltering heat, strict admonitions were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, during the depths of winter and the height of summer, the court issued strict orders to enforce these reforms.

sentences.zh: 常挺卒，贈少保。

translations.literal: Chang Ting died and was posthumously granted Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ting died and was posthumously honored as Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，行義役法。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Communal Corvée Law was enacted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Communal Corvée Law took effect.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，以夏貴爲沿江制置副使兼知黃州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, Xia Gui was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Yangzi Defense Command and concurrent Prefect of Huang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, Xia Gui was appointed vice commissioner of the Yangzi Defense Command and concurrent prefect of Huang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，史館狀《理宗實錄》接續起修。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Historiography Office reported that continuation of compiling the Veritable Records of Lizong was begun.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the Historiography Office reported that compilation of the Veritable Records of Lizong had resumed.

sentences.zh: 張九成、孫象先力學飭行，不墜家聲，其免一解示表厲。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiucheng and Sun Xiangxian vigorously pursued learning and disciplined their conduct without disgracing their family's reputation; they were exempted one round of the examinations as an example and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiucheng and Sun Xiangxian had studied diligently and conducted themselves with discipline without shaming their family's honor; they were exempted one round of the civil examinations as a model to others.

sentences.zh: 命建康府建南軒書院，祠先儒張栻，戊戌，汪立信知潭州兼湖南安撫使，職任依舊。

translations.literal: It was ordered that Jiankang Prefecture build the Nanzuan Academy to sacrifice to the former sage Zhang Shi; on wuxu, Wang Lixin was appointed Prefect of Tan Prefecture and concurrent Hunan Pacification Commissioner, his duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Jiankang Prefecture to build the Nanzuan Academy in honor of the former sage Zhang Shi; on wuxu, Wang Lixin was appointed prefect of Tan Prefecture and concurrent Hunan pacification commissioner, with his duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔賞京湖總管張喜、趙萬等石門阪堰戰功。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict rewarded Zhang Xi, Zhao Wan, and others, commanders of the Jing-Hu circuit, for battle merit at Shimenban Weir.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict rewarded Zhang Xi, Zhao Wan, and other commanders of the Jing-Hu circuit for their victory at Shimenban Weir.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁未，以李庭芝爲兩淮安撫制置大使兼知揚州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, the first month, on dingwei, Li Tingzhi was appointed Grand Pacification and Defense Commissioner of the Two Huai and concurrent Prefect of Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, first month of spring, on dingwei, Li Tingzhi was appointed grand pacification and defense commissioner of the Two Huai and concurrent prefect of Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬子，京湖策應司參謀呼延德領諸將張喜等遇北兵，戰於蠻河。

translations.literal: On renzi, Huyan De, staff officer of the Jing-Hu Response Office, leading the generals Zhang Xi and others, encountered northern troops and fought at Man River.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Huyan De, a staff officer of the Jing-Hu Response Office, leading generals including Zhang Xi, encountered northern troops and fought at Man River.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，葉夢鼎累章請老，留之，固辭，依前少保、判福州、福建安撫使，封信國公。

translations.literal: On guihai, Ye Mengding repeatedly submitted memorials requesting retirement; the emperor retained him, but he firmly declined, receiving as before the post of Junior Mentor, Administrator of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Commissioner, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Xinguo.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Ye Mengding repeatedly memorialized the throne requesting retirement; though the emperor urged him to stay, he steadfastly declined and was permitted to retire as Junior Mentor, administrator of Fuzhou and Fujian pacification commissioner, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Xinguo.

sentences.zh: 以馬廷鸞參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Ma Tingluan was appointed Vice Grand Councillor and concurrent Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Tingluan was appointed vice grand councillor and concurrent vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以江萬里參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Jiang Wanli was appointed Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Jiang Wanli was appointed vice grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，江萬里辭免參知政事，不允。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuzi, Jiang Wanli requested removal as Vice Grand Councillor; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi, Jiang Wanli requested dismissal as vice grand councillor; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，北帥阿術自白河以兵圍樊城。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingwu, the northern commander Achi led troops from White River to besiege Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingwu, the northern commander Achi led troops from White River to besiege Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，葉夢鼎辭免判福州、福建安撫使，詔不允。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Ye Mengding requested removal as Administrator of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Commissioner; an edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Ye Mengding requested dismissal as administrator of Fuzhou and Fujian pacification commissioner; the edict denied his request.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，皇后歸寧，族姻推恩，保信軍節度使全清夫以下五十六人各進一秩，咸安郡夫人全氏以下三十二人各特封有差。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Empress visited her natal home; grace was extended to clansmen and affines — fifty-six persons including Military Commissioner of Baoxin Army Quan Qingfu each advanced one rank; thirty-two persons including Lady of Commandery of Xian'an, Lady Quan, each received special enfeoffments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Empress paid a visit to her natal family; the court extended grace to her kin and affines — fifty-six persons, beginning with Quan Qingfu, military commissioner of the Baoxin Army, each advanced one rank; thirty-two women, beginning with Lady Quan, Lady of Commandery of Xian'an, received special enfeoffments in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 大元兵城鹿門。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops fortified Lumen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan troops built fortifications at Lumen.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔浙西六郡公田設官督租有差。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict ordered the six prefectures of western Zhejiang to establish officials to supervise public-field rent in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, an edict ordered officials appointed in the six Zhejiang prefectures to supervise public-field rent collection at varying levels.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，京湖都統張世傑率馬步舟師援襄、樊，戰於赤灘圃。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Zhang Shijie, Commander-in-Chief of Jing-Hu, led cavalry, infantry, and naval forces to relieve Xiangyang and Fancheng and fought at Chitanpu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhang Shijie, commander-in-chief of Jing-Hu, led cavalry, infantry, and river forces to relieve Xiangyang and Fancheng and fought at Chitanpu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以江萬里爲左丞相，馬廷鸞爲右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Jiang Wanli was appointed Left Grand Councillor and Ma Tingluan Right Grand Councillor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Jiang Wanli was appointed left grand councillor and Ma Tingluan right grand councillor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以馬光祖知樞密院事兼參知政事，吳革沿江制置使。

translations.literal: On jisi, Ma Guangzu was appointed Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Vice Grand Councillor; Wu Ge was appointed Yangzi Defense Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Ma Guangzu was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent vice grand councillor; Wu Ge was appointed Yangzi defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，賞張世傑戰功。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingzi, Zhang Shijie's battle merit was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingzi, Zhang Shijie was rewarded for his victories.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，江萬里、馬廷鸞辭免，詔不允。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Jiang Wanli and Ma Tingluan requested removal; an edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jiang Wanli and Ma Tingluan requested dismissal; the edict denied their requests.

sentences.zh: 壬午，知渠州張資上蓬州界白土、神山、蒲渡等處今年春戰功。

translations.literal: On renwu, Zhang Zi, Prefect of Qu Prefecture, reported this spring's battle merit at Baitu, Shenshan, Pudu, and other places on the border of Peng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhang Zi, prefect of Qu Prefecture, reported victories this spring at Baitu, Shenshan, Pudu, and other places on the Peng Prefecture border.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以安西都統張朝寶、利東路安撫張玨領兵護錢粟餉寧西軍，還至水磑頭，戰有功，詔推賞。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Anxi Commander-in-Chief Zhang Chaobao and Lidong Circuit Pacification Commissioner Zhang Jue led troops escorting money and grain to supply the Ningxi Army; returning to Shuiqiaotou, they fought with merit; an edict ordered graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhang Chaobao, commander-in-chief of Anxi, and Zhang Jue, pacification commissioner of the Lidong circuit, led troops escorting money and grain to supply the Ningxi Army; on returning to Shuiqiaotou they won a victory; an edict ordered graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 己丑，劉雄飛依舊樞密都承旨、知沅州兼常德、澧、辰、沅、靖五郡鎮撫使。

translations.literal: On jichou, Liu Xiongfei was restored to his former posts as Director of Bureau Affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Prefect of Yuan Prefecture, and concurrent Pacification Commissioner of the five prefectures of Changde, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Liu Xiongfei was restored to his former posts as director of bureau affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs, prefect of Yuan Prefecture, and concurrent pacification commissioner of Changde, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，李庭芝特進一秩。

translations.literal: On guisi, Li Tingzhi was specially advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Tingzhi received a special promotion of one rank.

sentences.zh: 高郵縣夏世賢七世義居，詔署其門。

translations.literal: In Gaoyou County, Xia Shixian's seven generations lived together in righteous community; an edict ordered his gate inscribed.
translations.idiomatic: In Gaoyou County, Xia Shixian's family had lived together in righteous harmony for seven generations; an edict ordered an honorific inscription for his gate.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，馬光祖依舊觀文殿學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiyou, Ma Guangzu was restored as before to Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Director of the Tongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiyou, Ma Guangzu was restored to his former posts as academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and director of the Tongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，程元鳳薨，贈少師。

translations.literal: On yimao, Cheng Yuanfeng died; he was posthumously granted Junior Master.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Cheng Yuanfeng died and was posthumously honored as Junior Master.

sentences.zh: 庚申，有星自鬥宿距星東北急流向牛宿，至濁沒。

translations.literal: On gengshen, a star from the determining star of the Dipper lodge flowed rapidly northeast toward the Ox lodge until obscured disappearance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, a star streaked rapidly northeast from the Dipper constellation's determining star toward the Ox constellation and vanished into haze.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔：信陽諸將婁安邦、朱興戰千石畈，呂文煥、呼延德戰福山，楊青、李忠戰石湫，俱有勞效，推賞有差。

translations.literal: On renxu, an edict stated: The Xinyang generals Lou Anbang and Zhu Xing fought at Qianshitan; Lü Wenhuan and Huyan De fought at Fushan; Yang Qing and Li Zhong fought at Shichiu — all had meritorious service; graded rewards were ordered in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, an edict ordered graded rewards for the Xinyang generals Lou Anbang and Zhu Xing, who fought at Qianshitan; Lü Wenhuan and Huyan De, who fought at Fushan; and Yang Qing and Li Zhong, who fought at Shichiu — all had rendered distinguished service.

sentences.zh: 壬申，京湖制司言：故夔路安撫徐宗武沒于王事，乞優加贈恤。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Jing-Hu Defense Office stated: The late Kui Circuit Pacification Commissioner Xu Zongwu died in service of the state; it requested exceptional posthumous honors and relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Jing-Hu Defense Office reported that Xu Zongwu, the late pacification commissioner of the Kui circuit, had died in the service of the state and requested exceptional posthumous honors and relief for his family.

sentences.zh: 詔致仕恩外，特官其一子承節郎。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that, beyond the grace accorded on retirement, one of his sons be specially appointed Chengji Lang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict further ordered that, in addition to the usual retirement honors, one of his sons be specially appointed Chengji Lang.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，以呂文福爲復州團練使、知濠州兼淮西安撫副使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengchen, Lü Wenfu was appointed Regimental Commissioner of Fuzhou, Prefect of Haozhou, and concurrently Vice Pacification Commissioner of Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen, Lü Wenfu was appointed regimental commissioner of Fuzhou, prefect of Haozhou, and concurrently vice pacification commissioner of the Huai West.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇子昰生。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the imperial prince Zhao was born.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the imperial prince Zhao was born.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，家鉉翁辭免新命，詔別授職。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Jia Xianweng declined and sought release from the new appointment; an edict assigned him a different office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Jia Xianweng declined the new appointment, and an edict assigned him a different post instead.

sentences.zh: 庚子，李庭芝辭免兼淮東提舉，不允。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Li Tingzhi submitted a memorial declining his concurrent post as Huaidong intendant; it was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Li Tingzhi asked to be relieved of his concurrent appointment as Huaidong intendant; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，觀文殿學士馬光祖乞守本官致仕，詔允所請。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, Academician of the Hall for Observing Literature Ma Guangzu requested to retire while retaining his original rank; an edict granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, Ma Guangzu, academician of the Hall for Observing Literature, asked to retire while retaining his present rank, and an edict approved his request.

sentences.zh: 庚申，祈雨。

translations.literal: On gengshen, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, prayers were offered for rain.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，東南有星自河鼓距星西北急流，至濁沒。

translations.literal: On renxu, in the southeast a star, starting from the determining star of the Drum at the River, sped rapidly northwest and disappeared when it reached a murky region.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, a star appeared in the southeast near the Drum at the River, streaked swiftly northwest, and vanished in murky sky.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，詔郡縣收民田租，毋巧計取贏，毋厚直折納，轉運司申嚴按劾。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuyin, an edict ordered prefectures and counties in collecting private field rents not to use crafty schemes to seize surplus and not to accept commutation at inflated rates; transport commissions were ordered to investigate and punish strictly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuyin, an edict directed prefectures and counties collecting field rents to abandon crafty schemes for surplus gain and inflated commutation rates, and ordered the transport commissions to investigate violations strictly.

sentences.zh: 詔襄、樊將士戰禦宣力，以錢二百萬犒師，趣上其立功姓名補轉官資。

translations.literal: An edict commended the officers and soldiers of Xiang and Fan who exerted themselves in battle and defense, allotted two million in cash to reward the troops, and urgently ordered that the names of those who had achieved merit be submitted for promotion in office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended the officers and soldiers defending Xiangyang and Fancheng, allotted two million cash to reward the troops, and ordered officials to submit promptly the names of those who had distinguished themselves so their ranks might be advanced.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，祈晴。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingwu, prayers were offered for clear weather.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, prayers were offered for fair weather.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Bright Hall was worshipped; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Bright Hall rites were performed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，明堂禮成，加上壽和聖福皇太后尊號冊、寶，太師、判大宗正事、福王、榮王祀事與芮加食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: On bingyin, when the Bright Hall rites were completed, honorary seals and regalia were added for the Empress Dowager of Longevity, Harmony, Sacred Blessing, and Good Fortune; the Grand Preceptor and Director of the Office of the Great Ancestor, the Prince of Fu, the Prince of Rong, and Yu Rui, who had overseen the sacrificial rites, each received an increase of one thousand taxable households in their fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, after the Bright Hall rites were completed, seals and regalia were added to the honorific title of the Empress Dowager of Longevity, Harmony, Sacred Blessing, and Good Fortune; the grand preceptor and director of the Office of the Great Ancestor, the Prince of Fu, the Prince of Rong, and Yu Rui, who had overseen the sacrificial duties, each received an increase of one thousand households in their fiefs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，子憲授檢校太尉、武安軍節度使，封益國公。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, Zi Xian was appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and Military Commissioner of the Wu'an Army, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yiguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, Zi Xian was appointed honorary grand marshal and military commissioner of the Wu'an Army and enfeoffed as Duke of Yiguo.

sentences.zh: 己丑，呂文德進封崇國公，加食邑七百戶。

translations.literal: On jichou, Lü Wende was advanced to Duke of Chongguo and given an increase of seven hundred taxable households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Lü Wende was promoted to Duke of Chongguo, with seven hundred additional households added to his fief.

sentences.zh: 以湯漢爲顯文閣直學士、提舉玉隆萬壽宮兼象山書院山長。

translations.literal: Tang Han was appointed Direct Academician of the Hall of Manifest Letters, Superintendent of the Jade Prosperity and Longevity Palace, and concurrently Head of the Xiangshan Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Han was appointed direct academician of the Hall of Manifest Letters, superintendent of the Jade Prosperity and Longevity Palace, and concurrently head of the Xiangshan Academy.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，少傅文德乞致仕，詔特授少師，進封衛國公，依所請致仕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, Junior Mentor Wende requested retirement; an edict specially appointed him Junior Preceptor, advanced him to Duke of Weiguo, and granted retirement as requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, Junior Mentor Lü Wende asked to retire; an edict made him junior preceptor, promoted him to Duke of Weiguo, and granted the retirement he sought.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，文德卒，贈太傅，賜諡武忠。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, Wende died; he was posthumously made Grand Mentor and granted the posthumous title Wuzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, Lü Wende died; he was posthumously honored as grand mentor and given the posthumous title Wuzhong, "Loyal in War."

sentences.zh: 己卯，以範文虎爲殿前副都指揮使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Fan Wenhu was appointed Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Palatial Front.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Fan Wenhu was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Palatial Front.

sentences.zh: 壽和聖福皇太后尊號冊寶禮成，侄謝堂、侄孫光孫等二十八人各轉一官，餘姻推恩有差。

translations.literal: When the rites for the empress dowager's honorary seals and regalia were completed, twenty-eight persons including nephew Xie Tang and grand-nephew Guangsun each received one step of promotion in rank, while other affinal kin received differentiated grace.
translations.idiomatic: After the ceremony conferring seals and regalia upon the empress dowager's honorific title, twenty-eight kinsmen including her nephew Xie Tang and grand-nephew Guangsun were each promoted one rank, while other relatives by marriage received honors according to degree.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以錢二百萬命京湖帥臣給犒襄、郢等處水陸戍士。

translations.literal: On jiashen, two million in cash was allotted; the Jing-Hu commander-in-chief was ordered to distribute rewards to the land and river garrison soldiers at Xiang, Ying, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, two million cash was allotted and the Jing-Hu commander-in-chief was ordered to distribute rewards to the garrison troops at Xiang, Ying, and other land and river posts.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔安南國王父陳日煚、國王陳威晃並加食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict ordered that Chen Rijiong, father of the king of Annam, and King Chen Weihuang each receive an increase of one thousand taxable households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, an edict granted Chen Rijiong, father of the king of Annam, and King Chen Weihuang each an increase of one thousand households in their fiefs.

sentences.zh: 大元兵築南新城。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops built the Southern New City.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces began building the Southern New City.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月壬寅，以李庭芝爲京湖安撫制置使兼夔路策應使，印應雷兩淮安撫制置使。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, on renyin in the first month, Li Tingzhi was appointed Jing-Hu Pacification Commissioner and Military Affairs Coordinator and concurrently Qielu Response Envoy; Yin Yinglei was appointed Two Huai Pacification Commissioner and Military Affairs Coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year, on renyin in the first month, Li Tingzhi was made Jing-Hu pacification commissioner and military affairs coordinator with concurrent duties as Qielu response envoy, and Yin Yinglei was made pacification commissioner and military affairs coordinator for the Two Huai.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以錢二百萬賜夔路策應司備禦賞給。

translations.literal: On jiyou, two million in cash was granted to the Qielu Response Office for defense preparations and reward distributions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, two million cash was granted to the Qielu response office for defensive preparations and rewards.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以高達爲湖北安撫使、知鄂州，孫虎臣起復淮東安撫副使、知淮安州。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Gao Da was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Hubei and Prefect of Ezhou; Sun Huchen was recalled from mourning to serve as Vice Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong and Prefect of Huai'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Gao Da was appointed pacification commissioner of Hubei and prefect of Ezhou; Sun Huchen was recalled from mourning to serve as vice pacification commissioner of Huaidong and prefect of Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，行《成天曆》，丁卯，上制《字民》、《牧民》二訓，以戒百官。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Completed Heavenly Calendar was put into use. On dingmao, the emperor composed two admonitions, "Cherishing the People" and "Governing the People," to warn the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Completed Heavenly Calendar was promulgated. On dingmao, the emperor composed two admonitions, "Cherishing the People" and "Governing the People," as warnings to the officials.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以江萬里爲福建安撫使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Jiang Wanli was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Jiang Wanli was appointed pacification commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，檢校少保、安德軍節度使與萊加食邑五百戶。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinwei, Honorary Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of the Ande Army Yu Lai received an increase of five hundred taxable households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei, Yu Lai, honorary junior guardian and military commissioner of the Ande Army, received five hundred additional households in his fief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，陳宜中經筵進講《春秋》終篇，賜象簡、金御仙花帶、鞍馬。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Chen Yizhong completed his lecture on the Spring and Autumn Annals before the classics mat; he was granted an ivory tally, a golden Immortal Flower belt for imperial use, and saddle and horse.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Chen Yizhong finished lecturing on the Spring and Autumn Annals at the classics mat and was rewarded with an ivory tally, a golden Immortal Flower belt for imperial use, and a saddle horse.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以呂文福爲淮西安撫副使兼知廬州。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Lü Wenfu was appointed Vice Pacification Commissioner of Huai West and concurrently Prefect of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Lü Wenfu was appointed vice pacification commissioner of the Huai West and concurrently prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，朱禩孫權兵部尚書，仍四川安撫制置、總領夔路轉運、知重慶府。

translations.literal: On jihai, Zhu Yisun was temporarily appointed Minister of War, and still served as Sichuan Pacification Commissioner and Military Affairs Coordinator, Overall Director of Qielu Transport, and Prefect of Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhu Yisun was temporarily appointed minister of war while retaining his posts as Sichuan pacification commissioner and military affairs coordinator, overall director of Qielu transport, and prefect of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengzi, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the third month, gengzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔曰：「吏以廉稱，自古有之，今絕不聞，豈不自章顯而壅于上聞歟？

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict said: "That officials are praised for integrity has existed since antiquity, yet today one never hears of it — is it not because they make themselves known but are blocked from reaching the throne?"
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, an edict declared: "Officials have been praised for integrity since antiquity, yet today such cases are never heard of. Is it not that worthy men make themselves known, only to be shut out from the throne's hearing?"

sentences.zh: 其令侍從、卿監、郎官，各舉廉吏，將顯擢焉。

translations.literal: Let the attendant officials, ministers and directors, and bureau officers each recommend incorrupt officials; they will be prominently promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Let attending officials, ministers and directors, and bureau officers each recommend incorrupt officials, who shall be prominently promoted.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，詔：「贛、吉、南安境數被寇，雖有砦卒，寇出沒無時，莫能相救。

translations.literal: " On guihai, an edict said: "The territories of Gan, Ji, and Nan'an have repeatedly suffered raids. Although there are stockade soldiers, the bandits appear and vanish at no fixed time, and none can rescue one another."
translations.idiomatic: " On guihai, an edict stated: "The prefectures of Gan, Ji, and Nan'an have suffered repeated raids. Though stockade garrisons exist, bandits strike unpredictably and cannot rescue one another."

sentences.zh: 宜即要衝立四砦，砦屯兵百，使地勢聯絡，禦寇爲便。

translations.literal: It is fitting immediately to establish four stockades at key points, with one hundred soldiers garrisoned in each stockade, so that the terrain is linked together and defense against bandits is convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Key passes should at once be fortified with four stockades, each garrisoned by a hundred men, so the positions link together and bandits may more easily be resisted.

sentences.zh: 從三郡擇將官領之。

translations.literal: From the three prefectures, select commanders to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders should be chosen from the three prefectures to command them.

sentences.zh: 」夏四月戊寅，以文天祥兼崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: " In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin, Wen Tianxiang was appointed concurrently Lecturer of the Hall of Exalted Governance.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin, Wen Tianxiang was appointed concurrently lecturer of the Hall of Exalted Governance.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，以吳革爲沿江制置宣撫使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinchou, Wu Ge was appointed Pacification and Exhortation Commissioner along the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinchou, Wu Ge was appointed pacification and exhortation commissioner along the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，詔《太極圖說》、《西銘》、《易傳序》、《春秋傳序》，天下士子宜肄其文。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengwu, an edict ordered that the Explanation of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate, the Western Inscription, the Preface to the Commentaries on the Changes, and the Preface to the Commentaries on the Spring and Autumn Annals — scholars throughout the realm should study their texts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengwu, an edict directed scholars throughout the realm to study the Explanation of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate, the Western Inscription, and the prefaces to the commentaries on the Changes and the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賈似道托疾退辭，疏十數上，上留益堅，禮異之，曰師相而不名。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Jia Sidao, pleading illness, submitted memorials requesting retirement; more than ten memorials were sent up. The emperor kept him with ever greater firmness, treating him with special ceremony and addressing him as Imperial Preceptor and Chancellor without speaking his name.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Jia Sidao pleaded illness and repeatedly memorialized the throne asking to retire — more than ten submissions in all. The emperor held him all the more firmly, honoring him with exceptional ceremony and addressing him as Imperial Preceptor and Chancellor without naming him.

sentences.zh: 馬廷鸞洎省、部、台諫、學館、諸司，連章請留似道。

translations.literal: Ma Tingluan, together with the provincial offices, ministries, censorate and remonstrance bureaus, academies, and various agencies, submitted successive memorials asking that Sidao be retained.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Tingluan, together with the provincial offices, ministries, censorate and remonstrance bureaus, academies, and various agencies, petitioned repeatedly that Jia Sidao be retained.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，子憲薨。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Zi Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Zi Xian died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔以襄、郢水陸屯戍將士隆暑露處，出錢二百萬，命京湖制司給賜。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict noted that because the land and river garrison soldiers at Xiang and Ying were exposed to the summer heat in open encampments, two million in cash was provided and the Jing-Hu Military Affairs Commission was ordered to distribute rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict noted that the garrison troops at Xiang and Ying, land and river alike, were suffering exposure in the summer heat, allotted two million cash, and ordered the Jing-Hu military affairs commission to distribute the funds.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，復開州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Kaizhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Kaizhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 己亥，更鑄印給之。

translations.literal: On jihai, seals were recast and issued.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, new seals were cast and issued.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，里安府樂清縣嘉禾生，詔薦士增四名。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiashen, in Yueqing County of Lin'an Prefecture, auspicious grain appeared; an edict increased the quota for recommended scholars by four.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, auspicious grain sprouted in Yueqing County of Lin'an Prefecture, and an edict added four places to the quota of recommended scholars.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔：郡縣行推排法，虛加寡弱戶田租，害民爲甚。

translations.literal: On renchen, an edict said: "Where prefectures and counties implement the survey-and-ranking law, they fictitiously add field rents to weak and impoverished households, harming the people severely."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, an edict declared that when prefectures and counties carried out the survey-and-ranking law, they falsely inflated the field rents of impoverished households, greatly harming the people.

sentences.zh: 其令各路監司詢訪，亟除其弊。

translations.literal: Let the supervisory officials of each circuit investigate and inquire, and promptly eliminate this abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory officials in each circuit were ordered to investigate and remove this abuse without delay.

sentences.zh: 詔精擇監司、守令，監司察郡守，郡守察縣令，置籍考核，歲終第其治狀來上。

translations.literal: An edict ordered meticulous selection of supervisory commissioners and prefects and magistrates; supervisory commissioners were to inspect prefects, prefects were to inspect magistrates; registers were established for assessment, and at year's end their records of governance were to be ranked and submitted upward.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the careful selection of circuit supervisors and local prefects and magistrates. Supervisors were to inspect prefects, prefects were to inspect magistrates; registers were kept for evaluation, and at year's end each man's performance was ranked and reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以夏貴能舉職事，進一秩。

translations.literal: On guisi, because Xia Gui was able to perform his duties, he was promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Xia Gui was promoted one rank for competent service.

sentences.zh: 詔似道十日一朝。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Sidao attend court once every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Sidao was ordered to attend court once every ten days.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，以黃萬石爲沿海制置使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengxu, Huang Wanshi was appointed Coastal Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengxu, Huang Wanshi was appointed coastal military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，台州大水。

translations.literal: On renzi, great flood in Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Taizhou suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，遣範文虎總統殿司、兩淮諸軍，往襄、樊會合備御，賜錢百五十萬犒師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingchou, Fan Wenhu was dispatched as commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard and the armies of the Two Huai, to unite with forces at Xiang and Fan for defense; one million five hundred thousand in cash was granted to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingchou, Fan Wenhu was sent to command the palace guard and Two Huai armies and join the defense at Xiangyang and Fancheng; 1.5 million cash was granted to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔台州發義倉米四千石併發豐儲倉米三萬石，振遭水家。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict ordered Taizhou to release four thousand shi from the charity granary together with thirty thousand shi from the Fengchu storage granary, to relieve households stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Taizhou was ordered to distribute four thousand shi from the charity granary and thirty thousand shi from the Fengchu granary to households afflicted by flood.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以陳宗禮、趙順孫兼權參知政事，依舊同提舉編修敕令、《經武要略》。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Chen Zongli and Zhao Shunsun were appointed acting Vice Grand Councilors, and as before jointly supervised the compilation of statutes and the Essential Military Records.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Chen Zongli and Zhao Shunsun were appointed acting vice grand councilors, continuing jointly to oversee compilation of statutes and the Essential Military Records.

sentences.zh: 閏十月己酉，安吉州水，免公田租四萬四千八十石。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month, on jiyou, Anji Prefecture suffered flooding; public-field rent of forty-four thousand eighty shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, on jiyou, flooding struck Anji Prefecture and public-field rent of 44,080 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔殿、步、馬諸軍貧乏陣沒孤遺者多，方此隆寒，其賜錢二十萬、米萬石振之。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict said that among the palace, infantry, and cavalry armies many were impoverished, battle-slain, or orphaned and bereft; now in this bitter cold, two hundred thousand in cash and ten thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, an edict noted that many men in the palace, infantry, and cavalry armies were impoverished, killed in battle, or left orphaned; amid the bitter cold, 200,000 cash and 10,000 shi of grain were granted for their relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，嘉興、華亭兩縣水，免公田租五萬一千石，民田租四千八百一十石。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, floods struck Jiaxing and Huating counties; public-field rent of fifty-one thousand shi and private-field rent of four thousand eight hundred ten shi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, floods hit Jiaxing and Huating counties; public-field rent of 51,000 shi and private-field rent of 4,810 shi were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔襄、郢屯戍將士隆寒可閔，其賜錢二百萬犒師。

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict said the garrison soldiers at Xiang and Ying in the bitter cold were pitiable; two million in cash was granted to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, an edict declared that the garrison troops at Xiang and Ying, exposed to bitter cold, deserved compassion; 2 million cash was granted to reward them.

sentences.zh: 己丑，都統張世傑領兵江防。

translations.literal: On jichou, Commander-in-chief Zhang Shijie led troops for Yangzi river defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Commander Zhang Shijie took charge of river defense along the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔陳宗禮進一秩，爲資政殿學士，依所請守兼參知政事致仕。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict ordered Chen Zongli promoted one rank, as Academician of the Hall of Supporting Governance, and in accordance with his request to retire while retaining his post as Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Chen Zongli was promoted one rank and named academician of the Hall of Supporting Governance; per his request, he was permitted to retire while retaining the title of vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，陳宗禮卒，贈七秩。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Chen Zongli died; seven ranks were posthumously granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Chen Zongli died and was posthumously advanced seven ranks.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔唐全、張興祖等齎蠟書入襄陽，往復甚艱，各補轉三官，賜錢二千緡。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict ordered that Tang Quan, Zhang Xingzu, and others, who had carried wax-sealed dispatches into Xiangyang and found the round trip exceedingly arduous, each be promoted three ranks and granted two thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Tang Quan, Zhang Xingzu, and others were each promoted three ranks and granted 2,000 strings of cash for the arduous round trip they had made carrying wax-sealed dispatches into Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 大元兵築萬山城。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops built Wanshan fort.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces constructed Wanshan fort.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月乙丑，子昰授左衛上將軍，進封建國公。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first month of the seventh year, on yichou, Zi Shi was granted Senior General of the Left Guard and was advanced and enfeoffed as Duke of Jianguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year, on yichou in the first month, Zi Shi was appointed senior general of the Left Guard and advanced to duke of Jianguo.

sentences.zh: 詔湯漢、洪天錫赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Tang Han and Hong Tiansi to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Han and Hong Tiansi were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 詔戒貪吏。

translations.literal: An edict warned against corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict admonished officials against corruption.

sentences.zh: 辛未，紹興府諸暨縣湖田水，免租二千八百石有奇。

translations.literal: On xinwei, lake-fields in Zhuji County of Shaoxing Prefecture suffered flooding; rent of slightly more than two thousand eight hundred shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, flooding inundated lake-fields in Zhuji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, and slightly more than 2,800 shi of rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，發屯田租谷十萬石，振和州、無爲、鎮巢、安慶諸州饑。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuyin, one hundred thousand shi of garrison-field grain rent was released to relieve famine in Hezhou, Wuwei, Zhenchao, and Anqing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, 100,000 shi of garrison-field grain was distributed to relieve famine in Hezhou, Wuwei, Zhenchao, and Anqing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，日暈，赤黃周匝。

translations.literal: On xinsi, there was a solar halo, red and yellow all around.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, a solar halo appeared, ringed in red and yellow.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，平江府饑，發官倉米六萬石。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Pingjiang Prefecture suffered famine; sixty thousand shi of grain was released from the government granary.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, famine struck Pingjiang Prefecture and 60,000 shi of grain was released from the government granaries.

sentences.zh: 吉州饑，發和糴米十萬石，皆減直振糶。

translations.literal: Jizhou suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of harmonized-purchase grain was released, all sold at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: During famine in Jizhou, 100,000 shi of harmonized-purchase grain was released and sold at reduced prices for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔減內外百司吏額。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict ordered reduction of the clerk quotas of the inner and outer hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, an edict ordered cuts to clerk quotas throughout the central and local administrations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，發米一萬石，往建德府濟糶。

translations.literal: On wuzi, ten thousand shi of grain was released and sent to Jiande Prefecture for famine relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, 10,000 shi of grain was sent to Jiande Prefecture for famine-relief sale.

sentences.zh: 詔臨江軍宣聖四十七代孫延之子孫，與放國子監試。

translations.literal: An edict granted the descendants of Yanzi, forty-seventh-generation descendant of the Sage in Linjiang Circuit, exemption from the Imperial Academy examination.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Confucius's forty-seventh-generation heir Yanzi in Linjiang Circuit were granted exemption from the Imperial Academy examination.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，免廣東提舉司鹽籮銀三萬兩。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinhai, thirty thousand taels of salt-basket silver of the Guangdong Intendant's office was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinhai, the Guangdong intendant's office was remitted 30,000 taels of salt-basket silver.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，禮部侍郎陳宜中再乞補外，以顯文閣待制出知福州兼福建路安撫使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Vice Minister of Rites Chen Yizhong again requested an external appointment; he was appointed Attendant-in-Waiting of the Xianwen Hall and sent out as Prefect of Fuzhou and concurrently Pacification Commissioner of the Fujian Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Vice Minister of Rites Chen Yizhong again petitioned for assignment outside the capital; he was named attendant-in-waiting of the Xianwen Hall and sent out as prefect of Fuzhou and concurrent Fujian pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，賜禮部進士張鎮孫以下五百二人及第、出身。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou, five hundred two men including Jinshi Zhang Zhensun of the Ministry of Rites were granted passing grades and initial appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiyou, 502 graduates led by Zhang Zhensun received jinshi degrees and initial appointments.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，發米二萬石，詣衢州振糶。

translations.literal: On renchen, twenty thousand shi of grain was released and sent to Quzhou for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, 20,000 shi of grain was sent to Quzhou for famine-relief sale.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，以錢百萬、銀五千兩命知嘉定府昝萬壽修城浚壕，繕甲兵，備禦遏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on ginsi, with one million in cash and five thousand taels of silver, Zan Wanshou, Prefect of Jiading Prefecture, was ordered to repair walls, dredge moats, maintain armor and weapons, and prepare for defense and containment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on ginsi, Zan Wanshou, prefect of Jiading, was given 1 million cash and 5,000 taels of silver to repair walls, dredge moats, outfit arms and armor, and prepare the defenses.

sentences.zh: 以韓震帶行御器械、知江安州兼潼川東路安撫副使，馬堃帶行御器械、知咸淳府、節制涪、萬州。

translations.literal: Han Zhen was granted acting Imperial Armory attendant, appointed Prefect of Jiangan Prefecture and concurrently Vice Pacification Commissioner of the Tongchuan East Route; Ma Kun was granted acting Imperial Armory attendant, appointed Prefect of Xianchun Prefecture, and placed in command of Fu and Wan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhen was given the acting post of imperial armory attendant and appointed prefect of Jiangan and vice pacification commissioner of the Tongchuan East Route; Ma Kun received the same armory attendant post, was made prefect of Xianchun, and given command of Fu and Wan.

sentences.zh: 台臣劾朱善孫督綱運受贓四萬五千，詔特貸死，配三千里，禁錮不赦。

translations.literal: Censorate officials impeached Zhu Shansun for supervising transport convoys and accepting bribes of forty-five thousand; an edict specially commuted the death penalty, banished him three thousand li, and imprisoned him without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials impeached Zhu Shansun for taking 45,000 in bribes while supervising transport; he was specially spared execution, exiled three thousand li, and imprisoned without hope of pardon.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔以蜀閫調度浩繁，賜錢二百萬給用。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict ordered that because the Sichuan frontier command's scheduling was vast and complex, two million in cash was granted for use.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, because the Sichuan frontier command faced heavy logistical demands, 2 million cash was granted for its use.

sentences.zh: 丙申，諸暨縣大雨、暴風、雷電，發米振遭水家。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zhuji County suffered heavy rain, violent wind, and thunder and lightning; grain was released to relieve flood-stricken households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, heavy rain, violent winds, and thunder struck Zhuji County and grain was distributed to households hit by flood.

sentences.zh: 瑞州民及流徙者饑，乏食，發義倉米一萬八千石，減直振糶。

translations.literal: The people of Ruizhou and displaced persons suffered famine and lacked food; eighteen thousand shi from the charity granary was released and sold at reduced price for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Starvation among the people of Ruizhou and displaced persons led to the release of 18,000 shi from the charity granary, sold at reduced prices for relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔以陸九淵孫溥補上州文學。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict appointed Lu Jiuyuan's grandson Pu as Literary Instructor of an Upper Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Lu Jiuyuan's grandson Pu was appointed literary instructor of an upper prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鎮江府轉輸米十萬石於五河新城積貯。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Zhenjiang Prefecture transported one hundred thousand shi of grain to Wuwu New City for storage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhenjiang Prefecture shipped 100,000 shi of grain to the new city at Wuwu for storage.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以隆暑，給錢二百萬賜襄、郢屯戍將士。

translations.literal: On guichou, because of the sweltering summer heat, two million in cash was provided to reward the garrison soldiers at Xiang and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, amid sweltering summer heat, 2 million cash was granted to reward the garrison troops at Xiang and Ying.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，撫州黃震言：「本州振荒勸分，前穀城縣尉饒立積米二百萬，靳不發廩，雖嘗監貸，宜正遏糴之罪。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Huang Zhen of Fuzhou said: "This prefecture's famine relief and encouragement of sharing — the former sheriff of Gucheng County, Rao Li, hoarded two million shi of grain, stingily refused to open the granary; although he was once placed under supervised loan, he ought to be punished for the crime of hoarding grain."
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Huang Zhen of Fuzhou reported: "During this prefecture's famine relief and calls for mutual aid, former Gucheng county sheriff Rao Li hoarded two million shi of grain and refused to open his stores. Though once placed under supervised lending, he should now be punished for grain hoarding."

sentences.zh: 」詔饒立削兩秩、武岡軍居住。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Rao Li stripped of two ranks and exiled to reside in Wugang Army.
translations.idiomatic: " Rao Li was stripped of two ranks and banished to Wugang Army.

sentences.zh: 洪天錫三辭召命，詔守臣勉諭赴闕。

translations.literal: Hong Tiansi thrice declined summons; an edict ordered local officials earnestly to instruct and urge him to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Tiansi declined summons three times; local officials were ordered to press him earnestly to come to court.

sentences.zh: 戊午，紹興府饑，振糧萬石。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Shaoxing Prefecture suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain was distributed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, famine struck Shaoxing Prefecture and 10,000 shi of grain was distributed for relief.

sentences.zh: 己未，兩淮五河築城具完，賜名安淮軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the fortifications at Wuwu among the Two Huai Five Rivers were fully completed; the name Anhuai Army was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, fortifications were completed at Wuwu on the Two Huai Five Rivers, and the garrison was named the Anhuai Army.

sentences.zh: 大元會兵圍襄陽。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops assembled and besieged Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces massed and besieged Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，樞密院言吳信、周旺齎蠟書入襄城，往復效勞，詔各補官三轉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, the Privy Council reported that Wu Xin and Zhou Wang, who had carried wax-sealed dispatches into Xiang fortress and rendered effective service on the round trip, were each ordered promoted three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, the Privy Council reported that Wu Xin and Zhou Wang, who had carried wax-sealed dispatches into Xiang fortress and served effectively on the round trip, were each promoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，湖南轉運司訪求先儒張栻後人義倫以聞，詔補將仕郎。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Hunan Transport Commission sought out Yilun, descendant of the former scholar Zhang Shi, and reported upward; an edict appointed him Gentleman for Forwarding.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Hunan transport commission located Yilun, a descendant of the scholar Zhang Shi, and reported his case; he was appointed gentleman for forwarding.

sentences.zh: 壬午，四川制置使朱禩孫言：「夏五以來，江水凡三泛溢，自嘉而渝，漂蕩城壁，樓櫓圮壞。

translations.literal: On renwu, Sichuan Military Affairs Commissioner Zhu Yisun said: "Since the fifth month of summer, the river waters have thrice overflowed; from Jia to Yu, city walls were swept away and tower parapets collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Sichuan military affairs commissioner Zhu Yisun memorialized: "Since the fifth month of summer, the rivers have flooded three times. From Jiazhou to Yuzhou, ramparts were washed away and watchtowers ruined.

sentences.zh: 又嘉定地震者再，被災害爲甚，乞賜黜罷，上答天譴。

translations.literal: Further, at Jiading there were earthquakes twice; those afflicted by disaster suffered severely. He begged to be dismissed and removed from office, to answer Heaven's rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: He added that Jiading had also suffered two earthquakes, with grievous damage throughout, and begged to be dismissed from office in answer to Heaven's rebuke.

sentences.zh: 」詔不允。

translations.literal: An edict did not grant [the request].
translations.idiomatic: The edict did not grant his request.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔：城五河，淮東制置印應雷具有勞績，進一秩，宣勞官屬將士皆推恩。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict [stated]: Regarding the fortification of Five Rivers, Huaidong Military Commissioner Yin Yinglei had meritorious achievements; he was promoted one rank; officials and soldiers who received merit proclamations all received extended favors.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict noted the fortification of Five Rivers: Huaidong Military Commissioner Yin Yinglei had rendered distinguished service, was promoted one rank, and all officials and soldiers honored at the merit ceremony received extended favors.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day renchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon renchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以錢三百萬，遣京湖制置李庭芝詣郢州調遣犒師。

translations.literal: On jiawu, with cash in the amount of three million, Jinghu Military Commissioner Li Tingzhi was dispatched to Ying Prefecture to arrange deployment and reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, three million cash was allocated to send Jinghu Military Commissioner Li Tingzhi to Ying Prefecture to arrange troop deployments and reward the army.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命沿江制置副使夏貴會合策應，以錢二百萬隨軍給用。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Vice Yangzi Defense Commissioner Xia Gui was ordered to meet and coordinate responsive strategy, with two million cash allocated for use with the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Vice Yangzi Defense Commissioner Xia Gui was ordered to coordinate joint strategy, with two million cash allocated for army use.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，顯文閣直學士湯漢、顯文閣直學士洪天錫各五辭召命，詔並昇華文閣學士，仍予祠祿。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yihai, Direct Academicians of the Xianwen Pavilion Tang Han and Hong Tianxi each declined the summons five times; an edict promoted both to Academicians of the Huawen Pavilion and still granted temple stipends.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai, Direct Academicians of the Xianwen Pavilion Tang Han and Hong Tianxi each declined their summons five times; an edict promoted both to Academicians of the Huawen Pavilion while still granting them temple stipends.

sentences.zh: 己丑，子㬎生。

translations.literal: On jichou, Zi Shi was born.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Zi Shi was born.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，少傅、嗣秀王與澤薨，詔贈少師，追封臨海郡王。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingshen, Junior Tutor and Succeeding Prince of Xiu Zhao Yuze died; an edict posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and retroactively enfeoffed him as Prince of Linhai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingshen, Junior Tutor and Succeeding Prince of Xiu Zhao Yuze died; an edict posthumously granted him Junior Preceptor and retroactively enfeoffed him as Prince of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，從政郎朱鑒孫進《群經要略》。

translations.literal: On guichou, Gentleman for Participation in Governance Zhu Jiansun presented the Essential Compendium of the Classics.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Gentleman for Participation in Governance Zhu Jiansun presented the Essential Compendium of the Classics.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔殿、步、馬諸軍貧乏陣沒孤遺者，方此隆寒，其賜錢二十萬、米萬石振之。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict [stated]: For palace, infantry, and cavalry forces who are impoverished or orphaned by death in battle — in this bitter cold season — two hundred thousand cash and ten thousand shi of grain shall be granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, an edict ordered relief for impoverished palace, infantry, and cavalry troops and orphans of those killed in battle: in this deep winter cold, two hundred thousand cash and ten thousand shi of grain were granted.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，詔民有以孝弟聞于鄉者，守、令其具名上聞，將旌異勞賜焉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guihai, an edict [stated]: For commoners famed in their villages for filial piety and brotherly conduct, prefects and magistrates shall submit their names in report; they will be specially honored and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guihai, an edict declared that commoners famed in their villages for filial piety and brotherly respect should have their names submitted by prefects and magistrates, to be specially honored and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 己已。

translations.literal: On jisi.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi.

sentences.zh: 詔湯漢官一轉，端明殿學士，依所請致仕。

translations.literal: An edict [stated]: Tang Han's office was advanced one rank to Chuanming Hall Academician; he was retired as requested.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced Tang Han one rank to Chuanming Hall Academician and granted retirement as he had requested.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，詔諸路監司循按刑獄，傔從擾民，御史台申嚴覺察。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiawu, an edict [stated]: Circuit supervisory officials who inspect prisons have retainers who harass the people; the Censorate shall sternly investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiawu, an edict noted that retainers accompanying circuit supervisors on prison inspections harass the people, and ordered the Censorate to investigate strictly.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以錢三十萬命四川制司下渠、洋、開州、寧西鎮撫使張朝寶創司犒師。

translations.literal: On bingwu, with cash in the amount of three hundred thousand, the Sichuan Military Commission was ordered to send funds to Pacification Commissioner Zhang Chaobao of Qu, Yang, Kaizhou, and Ningxi to establish an office and reward troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, three hundred thousand cash was allocated to order the Sichuan Military Commission to send funds to Pacification Commissioner Zhang Chaobao of Qu, Yang, Kaizhou, and Ningxi to establish an office and reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 己亥，淮東統領兼知鎮江府趙溍乞祠祿，不允。

translations.literal: On jihai, Huaidong Commander-in-Chief and concurrent Prefect of Zhenjiang Zhao Yin requested temple stipend; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Huaidong Commander-in-Chief and concurrent Prefect of Zhenjiang Zhao Yin requested a temple stipend; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 謝方叔特敘復元官職、惠國公致仕。

translations.literal: Xie Fangshu was specially restored to his original office and retired as Duke of Huiguo.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Fangshu was specially restored to his former office and permitted to retire as Duke of Huiguo.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，初置士籍。

translations.literal: On xinhai, scholar registers were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, registers of scholar households were established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔舉廉能材堪縣令者，侍從、台諫、給舍各舉十人，卿監、郎官各舉五人，制帥、監司各舉六人，知州、軍、監各舉二人。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict [stated]: Recommend upright and capable men suited to serve as county magistrates — attendants-in-ordinary, censorate remonstrators, and drafting-review officials each recommend ten; ministers and directors and department officials each five; military commissioners and circuit supervisors each six; prefects, army commanders, and supervisors each two.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, an edict called for recommendations of upright and capable men suited to county magistracies: attendants-in-ordinary, censorate and remonstrance officials, and drafting-review officials were each to recommend ten; ministers and directors and department officials five each; military commissioners and circuit supervisors six each; and prefects, army commissioners, and supervisors two each.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月庚申，詔：「朕惟崇儉必自宮禁始，自今宮禁敢以珠翠銷金爲首飾服用，必罰無貸。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, first month of spring, on gengshen, an edict [stated]: "We consider that reverencing frugality must begin with the palace confines; from now on whoever in the palace dares use pearls, kingfisher inlay, or gilt gold for head ornaments and attire shall be punished without leniency.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on gengshen in the first month of spring, an edict declared: "We hold that practicing frugality must begin within the palace. From now on, anyone in the palace who dares use pearls, jade inlay, or gilt gold for ornaments or dress shall be punished without exception.

sentences.zh: 臣庶之家，咸宜體悉。

translations.literal: Households of officials and commoners should all take this to heart.
translations.idiomatic: Households of officials and commoners should all heed this.

sentences.zh: 工匠犯者，亦如景祐制，必從重典。

translations.literal: Artisans who violate it shall likewise follow the Jingyou regulations; punishment shall surely follow the heavy statutes."
translations.idiomatic: Artisans who violate the rule shall likewise be punished under the Jingyou regulations, with no leniency."

sentences.zh: 」又詔：「有虞之世，三載考績，三考黜陟幽明。

translations.literal: Another edict [stated]: "In the age of Youyu, accomplishments were assessed every three years; after three assessments the dim were dismissed and the bright were promoted.
translations.idiomatic: A further edict declared: "In the age of Emperor Shun, officials were evaluated every three years, and after three evaluations the incompetent were dismissed and the capable promoted.

sentences.zh: 漢之爲吏者長子孫，則其遺意也。

translations.literal: That Han officials in office long enough to see their sons and grandsons [succeed them] reflects this intent.
translations.idiomatic: The Han practice of keeping officials long enough that their sons and grandsons followed them in office preserved this same intent.

sentences.zh: 比年吏習偷薄，人懷一切，計日待遷，事未克究，又望而之他。

translations.literal: In recent years officials' habits have grown lax and shallow; men harbor a get-it-done mentality, counting days until transfer; affairs are not brought to completion before they gaze elsewhere and move on.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years official practice has grown lax; men think only of quick fixes, counting the days until transfer — affairs are left unfinished as they already look toward their next post.

sentences.zh: 吏胥狎玩，竊弄官政，吾民奚賴焉？

translations.literal: Clerks and runners become familiar and play with official government; on what can our people rely?
translations.idiomatic: Clerks and runners grow familiar and manipulate official business — what can our people depend on?

sentences.zh: 繼自今內之郎曹，外之牧守以上，更不數易，其有治狀昭著，自宜獎異。

translations.literal: From now on, inner bureau department officials and outer prefects and above shall no longer be frequently changed; those whose governance records are clearly outstanding should naturally be distinguished and rewarded."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, inner bureau officials and outer prefects and above shall no longer be rotated frequently; those with outstanding records of governance should naturally be singled out for reward."

sentences.zh: 」辛未，子昺生。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zi Bing was born.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zi Bing was born.

sentences.zh: 己丑，湯漢卒，賜諡文清。

translations.literal: On jichou, Tang Han died; posthumous title Wenzing was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Tang Han died; he was granted the posthumous title Wenzing.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，謝方叔卒，贈少師。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guisi, Xie Fangshu died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guisi, Xie Fangshu died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 前知台州趙子寅歿，無所歸，特贈直秘閣，給沒官宅一區、田三百畝，養其孤遺，以旌廉吏。

translations.literal: Former Prefect of Taizhou Zhao Ziyin died with nowhere to return; he was specially granted Direct Secretarial Gentlemen of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, given one confiscated official residence and three hundred mu of fields, to support his orphaned survivors, in honor of an upright official.
translations.idiomatic: Former Prefect of Taizhou Zhao Ziyin died far from home with no place of return; he was specially granted Direct Secretarial Gentlemen of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, given one confiscated official residence and three hundred mu of land to support his orphaned survivors, in honor of an upright official.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以錢二百萬給犒襄、郢水陸戰戍將士。

translations.literal: On bingwu, two million cash was granted to reward the land and river garrison troops fighting at Xiang and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, two million cash was granted to reward the land and river garrison forces at Xiang and Ying.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，同知樞密院事兼權參知政事趙順孫授中大夫。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingzi, Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Grand Councillor Zhao Shunsun was appointed Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi, Vice Director of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Grand Councillor Zhao Shunsun was appointed Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，知合州、利路安撫張玨創築宜勝山城。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on wuzi, Prefect of He Prefecture and Lizhou Pacification Commissioner Zhang Jue newly built Yisheng Mountain Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuzi, Prefect of He Prefecture and Lizhou Pacification Commissioner Zhang Jue newly constructed Yisheng Mountain Fort.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，王爚除觀文殿學士、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jisi, Wang Yan was appointed Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Elevated Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey, and concurrent Reader-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, Wang Yan was appointed Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Elevated Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey, and concurrent Reader-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 大元兵久圍襄、樊，援兵厄關險，不克進。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops had long besieged Xiang and Fan; relief troops were blocked at strategic passes and defiles and could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces had long besieged Xiangyang and Fancheng; relief armies were checked at critical passes and could not break through.

sentences.zh: 詔荊、襄將帥移駐新郢，遣部轄張順、張貴將死士三千人自上流夜半輕舟轉戰。

translations.literal: An edict [stated]: Jing and Xiang generals moved their headquarters to New Ying; Department Commanders Zhang Shun and Zhang Gui were dispatched to lead three thousand death-defying troops from upstream, fighting by light boats at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Jing and Xiang commanders to relocate to New Ying and dispatched Commanders Zhang Shun and Zhang Gui to lead three thousand elite troops downstream by light boats, fighting through the night.

sentences.zh: 比明達襄城，收軍閱視，失張順。

translations.literal: By dawn they reached Xiang City; upon mustering the troops for inspection, Zhang Shun was missing.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn they reached Xiang City; when the troops were mustered and inspected, Zhang Shun was missing.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，皮龍榮徙衡州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingshen, Pi Longrong was transferred to Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen, Pi Longrong was transferred to Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以章鑒爲端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事、同提舉《經武要略》。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Zhang Jian was appointed Chuanming Hall Academician, Co-Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Co-Commissioner of the Essential Compendium of Classical Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhang Jian was appointed Chuanming Hall Academician, Co-Signatory of Military Affairs, and Co-Commissioner of the Essential Compendium of Classical Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以錢千萬命京湖制司糴米百萬石，轉輸襄陽府積貯。

translations.literal: With cash in the amount of ten million, the Jinghu Military Commission was ordered to purchase one million shi of grain and transport it for storage at Xiangyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ten million cash was allocated to order the Jinghu Military Commission to purchase one million shi of grain and transport it for storage at Xiangyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以家鉉翁兼權知紹興府、浙東安撫、提舉司事，以唐震爲浙西提點刑獄。

translations.literal: On yisi, Jia Xuanweng was appointed Acting Prefect of Shaoxing Prefecture and concurrent Zhedong Pacification Commissioner and Elevated Commissioner; Tang Zhen was appointed Zhexi Judicial Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Jia Xuanweng was appointed Acting Prefect of Shaoxing and concurrent Zhedong Pacification Commissioner and Elevated Commissioner; Tang Zhen was appointed Zhexi Judicial Intendant.

sentences.zh: 王爚乞寢新命，不允，勉諭赴闕。

translations.literal: Wang Yan requested that the new appointment be deferred; this was not granted, and he was urged to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan asked to decline the new appointment; the request was denied, and he was urged to proceed to court.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，台臣言江西推排田結局已久，舊設都官、團長等虛名尚在，占吝常役，爲害無窮，又言廣東運司銀場病民。

translations.literal: On xinhai, censorate officials reported that Jiangxi land reassessment had long been concluded, yet empty titles such as district officers and group heads still remained, monopolizing regular corvée and causing endless harm; they also reported that Guangdong Transport Commission silver mines afflicted the people.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, censorate officials reported that Jiangxi's land reassessment had long since ended, yet hollow titles such as district officers and group heads remained, hoarding regular corvée labor and causing endless harm; they also reported that Guangdong transport commission silver mines were harming the people.

sentences.zh: 詔俱罷之。

translations.literal: An edict abolished all of them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished all of these practices.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以錢五百萬命四川制司詣湖北糴運上峽入夔米五十萬石。

translations.literal: On guichou, with cash in the amount of five million, the Sichuan Military Commission was ordered to go to Hubei to purchase and transport five hundred thousand shi of grain up the gorges into Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, five million cash was allocated to order the Sichuan Military Commission to purchase grain in Hubei and transport five hundred thousand shi up the gorges into Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，知靜江府、廣西經略安撫使兼計度轉運使胡穎乞祠祿，詔勳一轉，依所乞宮觀。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinwei, Prefect of Jingjiang Prefecture and Guangxi Military Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner and Fiscal Transport Commissioner Hu Ying requested temple stipend; an edict granted one honorary rank advancement, granting the abbey appointment as requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, Prefect of Jingjiang and Guangxi Military Commissioner, Pacification Commissioner, and Fiscal Transport Commissioner Hu Ying requested a temple stipend; an edict granted him one honorary rank promotion and the requested abbey appointment.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day bingxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon bingxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔家鉉翁赴闕。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict ordered Jia Xuanweng to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, an edict ordered Jia Xuanweng to proceed to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，紹興府六邑水，發米振遭水家。

translations.literal: On dingwei, six districts of Shaoxing Prefecture suffered flooding; grain was dispensed to relieve flood-stricken households.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, six districts of Shaoxing Prefecture were inundated; grain was issued to relieve households stricken by the flood.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王爚辭免明堂大禮陪祠。

translations.literal: On renzi, Wang Yan declined to serve as attendant at the Bright Hall grand rite.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wang Yan declined to attend the Bright Hall grand rite as a sacrificial attendant.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔福建安撫陳宜中克舉厥職，升寶謨閣待制。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict [stated that] Fujian Pacification Commissioner Chen Yizhong had fully discharged his duties and promoted him to Baomo Hall Drafting Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict commended Fujian Pacification Commissioner Chen Yizhong for fully discharging his duties and promoted him to Baomo Hall Drafting Attendant.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，詔洪天錫轉端明殿學士，允所請致仕，辛未，明堂禮成，祀景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingmao, an edict transferred Hong Tiansi to Chuanming Hall Academician and granted his requested retirement; on xinwei, the Bright Hall rite was completed and the Jingling Palace was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao, an edict transferred Hong Tiansi to Chuanming Hall Academician and granted his request to retire; on xinwei, the Bright Hall rite was completed and sacrifice was offered at the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 還遇大雨，改乘逍遙輦入和寧門，肆赦。

translations.literal: On the return [journey] they encountered heavy rain; [the emperor] changed to the Leisurely Carriage to enter Hening Gate, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
