translations.idiomatic: On the return journey they encountered heavy rain; the emperor changed to the Leisurely Carriage to enter Hening Gate, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔以朱禩孫兼四川屯田使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict appointed Zhu Lisun concurrently Sichuan Field Cultivation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, an edict appointed Zhu Lisun concurrent Sichuan Field Cultivation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，洪天錫卒，贈五官，諡文毅。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Hong Tiansi died; he was posthumously granted five ranks and given the posthumous title Wenyi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Hong Tiansi died; he was posthumously granted five ranks and given the posthumous title Wenyi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，紹興府言八月一日，會稽、余姚、上虞、諸暨、蕭山五縣大水，詔減田租有差。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jihai, Shaoxing Prefecture reported that on the first day of the eighth month Kuaiji, Yuyao, Shangyu, Zhuji, and Xiaoshan five counties suffered great flooding; an edict reduced land tax by varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jihai, Shaoxing Prefecture reported that on the first day of the eighth month the five counties of Kuaiji, Yuyao, Shangyu, Zhuji, and Xiaoshan had suffered severe flooding; an edict reduced land tax by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以章鑒兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Zhang Jian was appointed Acting Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zhang Jian was appointed Acting Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 右丞相馬廷鸞十疏乞骸骨，詔不允。

translations.literal: Right Grand Councillor Ma Tingluan submitted ten memorials requesting retirement; an edict did not grant this.
translations.idiomatic: Right Grand Councillor Ma Tingluan submitted ten memorials asking to retire; an edict denied the request.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以秋雨水溢，詔減錢塘、仁和兩縣民田租什二，會稽湖田租什三，諸暨湖田租盡除之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, because autumn rains caused floods, an edict reduced civilian land tax in Qiantang and Renhe two counties by two-tenths, lake-field tax in Kuaiji by three-tenths, and entirely remitted lake-field tax in Zhuji.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, because autumn rains had caused flooding, an edict reduced civilian land tax in Qiantang and Renhe by two-tenths, lake-field tax in Kuaiji by three-tenths, and entirely remitted lake-field tax in Zhuji.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，陳宜中兼給事中。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Chen Yizhong was appointed concurrent Drafting Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Chen Yizhong was appointed concurrent Drafting Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，右丞相馬廷鸞累疏乞骸骨，授觀文殿學士、知饒州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yimao, Right Grand Councillor Ma Tingluan repeatedly submitted memorials requesting retirement; he was appointed Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Prefect of Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao, Right Grand Councillor Ma Tingluan repeatedly asked to retire; he was appointed Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 詔以隆寒，殿、步、馬司諸軍貧窶並陣沒孤遺者，振以錢粟。

translations.literal: An edict [stated that], because of severe cold, the destitute among the Palace, Foot, and Cavalry Guard armies and the orphaned survivors of those killed in battle were to be relieved with cash and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Because of severe cold, an edict ordered relief in cash and grain for the destitute among the Palace, Foot, and Cavalry Guard armies and for the orphaned survivors of those killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，陳奕以殿前都指揮使攝侍衛步軍司、馬軍司。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Chen Yi, as Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Front Guard, acted concurrently as head of the Palace Foot Guard and Cavalry Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Chen Yi, as Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Front Guard, was appointed acting head of the Palace Foot Guard and Cavalry Guard.

sentences.zh: 己未，馬廷鸞辭免知饒州，乞祠祿。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Ma Tingluan declined the appointment as Prefect of Raozhou and requested a temple stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Ma Tingluan declined the post of Prefect of Raozhou and requested a temple stipend.

sentences.zh: 詔以所請，以觀文殿大學士、鄱陽郡公提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: An edict granted his request, appointing him Great Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Duke of Poyang, and Elevated Commissioner of Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted his request and appointed him Great Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Duke of Poyang, and Elevated Commissioner of Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命阮思聰赴樞密院廩議。

translations.literal: On renxu, Ruan Sicong was ordered to proceed to the Bureau of Military Affairs for grain deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Ruan Sicong was ordered to attend grain deliberation at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔明堂禮成，安南國王陳日煚、陳威晃各加食邑一千戶，賜鞭、鞍、馬等物。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict [stated that], because the Bright Hall rite had been completed, the kings of Annam Chen Rijiong and Chen Weihuang were each granted an additional fief of one thousand households and bestowed whips, saddles, horses, and other items.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, because the Bright Hall rite had been completed, an edict granted the kings of Annam Chen Rijiong and Chen Weihuang each an additional fief of one thousand households and bestowed whips, saddles, horses, and other gifts.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，以葉夢鼎爲少傅、右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiayin, Ye Mengding was appointed Junior Tutor, Right Grand Councillor, and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiayin, Ye Mengding was appointed Junior Tutor, Right Grand Councillor, and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙丑，樊城破，範天順、牛富死之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, the first month, on yichou, Fancheng fell; Fan Tianshun and Niu Fu died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, spring, the first month, on yichou, Fancheng fell; Fan Tianshun and Niu Fu died defending it.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔定安豐統制金文彪、朱文廣、王文顯、盛全氵戎河、古河、泉河、瑉河等處戰功行賞。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict ordered rewards for military achievements at Anfeng Military Commission commanders Jin Wenbiao, Zhu Wenguang, Wang Wenxian, and Sheng Quan and at Xu River, Gu River, Quan River, Min River, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict ordered rewards for battle merits earned by Anfeng Military Commission commanders Jin Wenbiao, Zhu Wenguang, Wang Wenxian, and Sheng Quan and at Xu River, Gu River, Quan River, Min River, and other sites.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，詔鄂州左水軍統制張順沒身戰陣，贈寧遠軍承宣使，官其二子承信郎，立廟京湖，賜額曰忠顯。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiashen, an edict [stated that] Left Naval Controller of E Prefecture Zhang Shun had died in battle; he was posthumously granted Military Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army, his two sons were appointed Gentlemen for Fidelity in Trust, a temple was established in Jinghu, and the plaque bestowed read Zhongxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen, an edict honored Left Naval Controller of E Prefecture Zhang Shun, who had fallen in battle; he was posthumously granted Military Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army, his two sons were appointed Gentlemen for Fidelity in Trust, a temple was established in Jinghu, and the bestowed plaque read Zhongxian.

sentences.zh: 甲午，朱禩孫撫綏備禦，義不辭難，敕書獎諭。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhu Lisun had pacified and defended the frontier and, in righteousness, did not shirk hardship; an imperial letter commended and instructed him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhu Lisun had pacified and defended the frontier without shirking hardship; an imperial letter commended him.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以夏貴檢校少保。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Xia Gui was appointed Honorary Vice Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Xia Gui was appointed Honorary Vice Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，呂文煥以襄陽府歸大元。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Lü Wenhuan surrendered Xiangyang Prefecture to the Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Lü Wenhuan surrendered Xiangyang Prefecture to the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以朱澗寺戰功，推賞來歸人馬宣、沿江都統王喜等將士千五百七十餘人。

translations.literal: On guichou, because of battle achievements at Zhujian Temple, rewards were extended to more than one thousand five hundred seventy officers and soldiers including the returned defector Ma Xuan and River Defense Commander Wang Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, for battle achievements at Zhujian Temple, rewards were extended to more than one thousand five hundred seventy officers and soldiers, including the returned defector Ma Xuan and River Defense Commander Wang Xi.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，賈似道言邊遽日聞，請督師以勵將帥。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengshen, Jia Sidao reported that border emergencies were heard of daily and requested to take command in person to encourage generals and commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, Jia Sidao reported that border emergencies were arriving daily and asked to take personal command to encourage the generals.

sentences.zh: 詔不允。

translations.literal: An edict did not grant this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict denied the request.

sentences.zh: 四川制司言：「近出師成都，劉整故吏羅鑒自北復還，上整書稿一帙，有取江南二策：其一曰先取全蜀，蜀平，江南可定；

translations.literal: The Sichuan Military Commission reported: "Recently, when troops were dispatched from Chengdu, Luo Jian, a former clerk of Liu Zheng, returned from the north and submitted a volume of Liu Zheng's writings, containing two strategies for taking the Jiangnan region: the first said to take all of Shu first; once Shu was pacified, the Jiangnan could be secured;
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan Military Commission reported: "Recently, when troops were dispatched from Chengdu, Luo Jian, a former clerk of Liu Zheng, returned from the north and submitted a volume of Liu Zheng's writings containing two strategies for conquering the south: the first was to take all of Shu first; once Shu was pacified, the Jiangnan could be secured;

sentences.zh: 其二曰清口、桃源，河、淮要衝，宜先城其地，屯山東軍以圖進取。

translations.literal: the second said that Qingkou and Taoyuan, strategic points on the Yellow and Huai rivers, should first be fortified, and Shandong troops stationed there to plan an advance."
translations.idiomatic: the second was that Qingkou and Taoyuan, strategic points on the Yellow and Huai rivers, should first be fortified and garrisoned with Shandong troops to prepare an advance."

sentences.zh: 」帝覽奏，亟詔淮東制司往清口，擇利城築以備之。

translations.literal: The emperor reviewed the memorial and urgently ordered the Huaidong Military Commission to proceed to Qingkou, select a favorable site, and build fortifications in preparation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reviewed the memorial and urgently ordered the Huaidong Military Commission to go to Qingkou, choose a favorable site, and build fortifications in preparation.

sentences.zh: 葉夢鼎辭免右丞相，詔不允。

translations.literal: Ye Mengding declined the post of Right Grand Councillor; an edict did not grant this.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mengding declined the post of Right Grand Councillor; an edict denied the request.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣金吾衛上將軍阮思聰由平江、鎮江及黃州行視城池，凡合繕修增易者亟條奏。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Senior General of the Gold Crow Guard Ruan Sicong was dispatched via Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, and Huang Prefecture to inspect fortifications; wherever repairs, additions, or changes were needed, he was to report items urgently.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Senior General of the Gold Crow Guard Ruan Sicong was dispatched through Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, and Huang Prefecture to inspect fortifications and urgently report any needed repairs, additions, or changes.

sentences.zh: 丙子，來歸人方德秀補成忠郎，栗勇、楊林、胡巨川補保義郎，劉全補承信郎。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the returned defector Fang Dexiu was appointed Gentleman for Accomplished Loyalty; Li Yong, Yang Lin, and Hu Juchuan were appointed Gentlemen for Preserving Righteousness; Liu Quan was appointed Gentleman for Fidelity in Trust.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the returned defector Fang Dexiu was appointed Gentleman for Accomplished Loyalty; Li Yong, Yang Lin, and Hu Juchuan were appointed Gentlemen for Preserving Righteousness; and Liu Quan was appointed Gentleman for Fidelity in Trust.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賈似道始奏李庭芝表言襄帥呂文煥以城降大元。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Jia Sidao at last reported Li Tingzhi's memorial stating that Xiang Commander Lü Wenhuan had surrendered the city to the Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Jia Sidao at last reported Li Tingzhi's memorial stating that Xiangyang Commander Lü Wenhuan had surrendered the city to the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，加昝萬壽寧遠軍承宣使、職任仍舊。

translations.literal: On jimao, Zan Wanshou was promoted to Military Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army, with his duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zan Wanshou was promoted to Military Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army while retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，夏貴辭免檢校少保，不允。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Xia Gui declined the honorary appointment as Vice Junior Guardian; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Xia Gui declined the honorary appointment as Vice Junior Guardian; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔建機速房，以革樞密院漏泄兵事、稽違邊報之弊。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict ordered the establishment of the Rapid Dispatch Office to reform the abuses of the Bureau of Military Affairs leaking military affairs and delaying border reports.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, an edict ordered the establishment of the Rapid Dispatch Office to remedy the Bureau of Military Affairs' leaks of military information and delays in border reports.

sentences.zh: 賈似道累疏請身督師，詔勉留。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao repeatedly submitted memorials requesting to take personal command of the army; an edict urged him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao repeatedly asked to take personal command of the army; an edict urged him to stay at his post.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，詔褒襄城死節，右領衛將軍范天順贈靜江軍承宣使，右武大夫、馬司統制牛富贈金州觀察使，各官其二子承信郎，賜土田、金幣恤其家。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, an edict honored those who died defending Fan City with integrity; Right Rear Guard General Fan Tianshun was posthumously granted Military Commissioner of the Jingjiang Army, and Right Martial Grand Master and Cavalry Command Controller Niu Fu was posthumously granted Observer of Jin Prefecture; each man's two sons were appointed Gentlemen for Fidelity in Trust, and land, gold, and cash were bestowed to comfort their families.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, an edict honored those who died defending Fan City; Right Rear Guard General Fan Tianshun was posthumously granted Military Commissioner of the Jingjiang Army, and Right Martial Grand Master and Cavalry Command Controller Niu Fu was posthumously granted Observer of Jin Prefecture; each man's two sons were appointed Gentlemen for Fidelity in Trust, and land, gold, and cash were bestowed to support their families.

sentences.zh: 甲申，汪立信權兵部尚書、京湖安撫制置使、知江陵府、夔路策應使、湖廣總領，不許辭免。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wang Lixin was appointed Acting Minister of War, Jinghu Pacification and Military Commissioner, Prefect of Jiangling Prefecture, Kuizhou Route Support Commissioner, and Huguang Fiscal Commissioner; he was not permitted to decline.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wang Lixin was appointed Acting Minister of War, Jinghu Pacification and Military Commissioner, Prefect of Jiangling, Kuizhou Route Support Commissioner, and Huguang Fiscal Commissioner; he was not permitted to decline.

sentences.zh: 以錢二百萬給立信開閫犒師。

translations.literal: Two million cash was granted to Lixin to establish headquarters and reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Two million cash was granted to Lixin to establish his command headquarters and reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 葉夢鼎乞致仕，遣官勉諭赴都堂治事。

translations.literal: Ye Mengding requested retirement; an official was dispatched to urge him to proceed to the chief council hall to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mengding asked to retire; an official was dispatched to urge him to return to the chief council hall and resume his duties.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以趙溍爲淮西總領兼沿江制置、建康留守。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zhao Jin was appointed Huaixi Fiscal Commissioner and concurrent River Defense Commissioner and Garrison Commander of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Zhao Jin was appointed Huaixi Fiscal Commissioner and concurrent River Defense Commissioner and Garrison Commander of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 詔黃萬石赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huang Wanshi to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Huang Wanshi to proceed to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔：「襄陽六年之守，一旦而失，軍民離散，痛切朕心。

translations.literal: On renchen, an edict [stated]: "Xiangyang was defended for six years, yet in a single day it was lost; soldiers and civilians were scattered—this cuts deeply into my heart."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, an edict declared: "Xiangyang was defended for six years, yet in a single day it was lost; soldiers and civilians were scattered—this cuts me to the heart."

sentences.zh: 今年乾會節，其免集英殿宴，以錢六十萬給沿江制置趙溍江防捍禦。

translations.literal: This year, on the Qianhui Festival, the banquet at the Hall for Assembling Excellence is to be canceled, and six hundred thousand cash is to be granted to River Defense Commissioner Zhao Jin for river defense and protection.
translations.idiomatic: This year, on the Qianhui Festival, the banquet at the Hall for Assembling Excellence is to be canceled, and six hundred thousand cash is to be granted to River Defense Commissioner Zhao Jin for river defense.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，知招信軍陳岩乞祠祿。

translations.literal: On guisi, Prefect of Zhaoxin Prefecture Chen Yan requested a temple stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Prefect of Zhaoxin Chen Yan requested a temple stipend.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「乃者邊吏弗戒，致有襄難，將士頻歲暴露，邊民蕩析離居，衋傷朕心。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Recently border officials failed to remain vigilant, causing the Xiangyang calamity; officers and soldiers have been exposed to the elements year after year, and border people have been scattered and torn from their homes—this grieves my heart sorely."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Recently border officials failed to remain vigilant, bringing on the Xiangyang calamity; officers and soldiers have endured exposure year after year, and border people have been scattered from their homes—this grieves my heart sorely."

sentences.zh: 爾閫臣專征方面，宜身率諸將，宣揚國威，以賞戮用命不用命。

translations.literal: You circuit commanders with sole charge over campaigning in the regions should personally lead the generals, proclaim the state's majesty, and through reward and punishment employ those who obey orders and not those who disobey.
translations.idiomatic: As circuit commanders with full authority over campaigning in the provinces, you should lead your generals in person, uphold the majesty of the state, and use reward and punishment to distinguish those who follow orders from those who do not.

sentences.zh: 爾守臣有土有民，宜申儆國人，保固封守。

translations.literal: You territorial officials who have land and people should sternly warn the people of the realm and firmly secure the frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: You territorial officials with lands and peoples under your charge should rally the people to vigilance and hold fast to your defenses.

sentences.zh: 爾諸將尚迪果毅，一乃心力，各以其兵，敵王所愾。

translations.literal: You generals should strive to practice resoluteness and courage, unite your hearts and strength, and each with your troops strike the foe upon whom the king directs his wrath.
translations.idiomatic: You generals must cultivate resoluteness and courage, unite your hearts and your strength, and with your respective forces strike down the enemies upon whom the throne has fixed its wrath.

sentences.zh: 今朕多誥，爾其悉聽明訓，毋懈毋忄耎，習于故常，功多有厚賞，爾不克用勸，罰固不得私也。

translations.literal: Now I have many instructions; you all should fully heed these clear teachings, be neither slack nor faint-hearted, and keep to your former duties. Where merit is great there will be rich rewards; if you cannot employ encouragement, punishment likewise may not be withheld in private favor.
translations.idiomatic: I have much more to say. Hear these instructions clearly, be neither lax nor faint-hearted, and keep to your established duties. Great merit will earn rich rewards; where encouragement fails, punishment will be applied without favoritism.

sentences.zh: 又如中外小大臣僚，有材識超卓、明控禦之宜、懷攻守之略者，密具以聞，一如端拱二年制書，朕當虛心以聽。

translations.literal: And again, among civil and military officials great and small, any who have outstanding talent and insight, who understand what is appropriate for defense and control, and who harbor strategies of attack and defense should secretly report in full, just as in the edict of the second year of Duangong; I shall listen with an open heart.
translations.idiomatic: Further, if any official at court or in the provinces, high or low, possesses exceptional talent, understands what is fit for border defense, or has devised strategies of attack and defense, let him report the details in confidence, as under the edict of the second year of Duangong; I shall hear him with an open mind.

sentences.zh: 」李庭芝乞解罷，詔赴闕。

translations.literal: " Li Tingzhi requested to resign and be dismissed; an edict ordered him to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: " Li Tingzhi petitioned to resign; an edict summoned him to court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔復置樞密院都統制、副都統制各一員。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict restored one each of the Bureau of Military Affairs chief overall commander and deputy chief overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict restored to one each the posts of chief overall commander and deputy chief overall commander of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以高達爲寧江軍節度使、湖北安撫使、知峽州。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Gao Da was made Military Commissioner of the Ningjiang Army, Hubei Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Gao Da was appointed Military Commissioner of the Ningjiang Army, Hubei Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 詔忠州潛已升咸淳府，刺史王達改授高州刺史。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Qian of Zhongzhou had already been elevated to Xianchun Prefecture; the prefect Wang Da was transferred to the post of prefect of Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Qian in Zhongzhou had already been elevated to Xianchun Prefecture; the prefect Wang Da was reassigned as prefect of Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 李庭芝辭召赴闕，詔與祠。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi declined the summons to court; an edict granted him a nominal stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi declined the summons to court; an edict granted him a nominal sinecure instead.

sentences.zh: 巳酉，詔：「南歸人復有戰功者予優賞，楊春、薛聚成、陳君謨、周海、周興各補成忠郎，蕭成、侯喜、丁甫、劉鑄、鄭歸各補承信郎。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an edict stated: "Among those who had returned from the south, those who again achieved merit in battle shall receive exceptional rewards. Yang Chun, Xue Jucheng, Chen Junmo, Zhou Hai, and Zhou Xing were each appointed Gentleman of Complete Loyalty; Xiao Cheng, Hou Xi, Ding Fu, Liu Zhu, and Zheng Gui were each appointed Gentleman of Sincere Trustworthiness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, an edict stated: "Returners from the south who again distinguish themselves in battle shall receive special rewards. Yang Chun, Xue Jucheng, Chen Junmo, Zhou Hai, and Zhou Xing were each appointed Gentleman of Complete Loyalty; Xiao Cheng, Hou Xi, Ding Fu, Liu Zhu, and Zheng Gui were each appointed Gentleman of Sincere Trustworthiness.

sentences.zh: 」以夏貴兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: " Xia Gui was appointed concurrently Grand Commander of the Palace Horse Guard.
translations.idiomatic: " Xia Gui was appointed concurrently Grand Commander of the Palace Horse Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔汪立信賞罰調用悉聽便宜行事。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict granted Wang Lixin full discretion to reward, punish, transfer, and deploy as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, an edict authorized Wang Lixin to reward, punish, transfer, and deploy troops at his discretion as local circumstances demanded.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，呂師夔言：「比賈似道得李庭芝書，報臣叔父文煥以襄城降，臣聞之隕越無地，不能頃刻自安。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Lü Shiyao spoke, saying: "Recently Jia Sidao received a letter from Li Tingzhi reporting that my uncle Wen Huan had surrendered Xiangcheng. Upon hearing this I was stricken with shame beyond measure and could not find a moment's peace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Lü Shiyao submitted: "Recently Jia Sidao received a letter from Li Tingzhi reporting that my uncle Wen Huan had surrendered Xiangcheng. When I heard it, shame left me nowhere to hide, and I could not rest for a moment.

sentences.zh: 請以經略安撫、轉運、靜江府印委次官護之，席槁俟命，容臣歸省偏親，誓當趨事赴功，毀家紓難，以贖門戶之愆，以報君父之造。

translations.literal: I request that the seals of the Military Commission, Pacification Commission, and Jingjiang Prefecture be entrusted to subordinate officials for safekeeping; I sit upon straw awaiting judgment, and ask leave to return home to visit my aged parent. I vow to rush to service and achieve merit, ruin my household to relieve the crisis, to redeem my family's fault and repay my sovereign and father's grace in creating me.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the seals of the Military Commission, the Pacification Commission, and Jingjiang Prefecture be held in trust by my deputies. I sit upon straw awaiting your command and beg leave to visit my aged parent at home. I swear to throw myself into service, ruin my family if need be to meet this crisis, redeem my house's disgrace, and repay the grace of sovereign and father.

sentences.zh: 」詔不允。

translations.literal: " An edict did not grant his request.
translations.idiomatic: " The edict denied his request.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，以黃萬石權戶部尚書兼知臨安府、浙西安撫使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao, Huang Wanshi was appointed Acting Minister of Revenue with concurrent duty as prefect of Lin'an and Zhexi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao, Huang Wanshi was made Acting Minister of Revenue, with concurrent appointments as prefect of Lin'an and Zhexi Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四川制司朱禩孫言：「所部諸縣除正辟文臣外，諸郡屬邑，許令本司不拘外縣一體選辟文臣，以幸蜀之士民。

translations.literal: Zhu Huisun of the Sichuan strategic office stated: "Apart from regularly appointed civil officials in the counties under my jurisdiction, in the subordinate districts of the various prefectures I ask permission for this office, without restriction to outsiders from other counties, to select and appoint civil officials as a whole, for the sake of the gentry and commoners of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Huisun of the Sichuan strategic office reported: "Beyond the civil officials formally appointed in the counties under my command, I ask that this office be permitted, without treating outside counties differently, to appoint civil officials in subordinate districts alike, for the benefit of the gentry and people of Shu.

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，知廬州呂文福言：「從兄文煥以襄陽降，爲其玷辱，何顏以任邊寄，乞放罷歸田裏。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Lü Wenfu, prefect of Luzhou, stated: "My elder cousin Wen Huan surrendered Xiangyang; for the stain this brings I have no face to bear frontier responsibility. I beg to be dismissed and returned to my fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Lü Wenfu, prefect of Luzhou, reported: "My elder cousin Wen Huan surrendered Xiangyang. The shame he has brought upon us leaves me no face to hold border command. I beg to be relieved and sent home to my fields.

sentences.zh: 」詔不允。

translations.literal: " An edict did not grant his request.
translations.idiomatic: " The edict denied his request.

sentences.zh: 呂師夔五疏乞罷任，詔赴闕。

translations.literal: Lü Shiyao five times memorialized asking to be removed from office; an edict ordered him to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Shiyao five times petitioned to resign; an edict summoned him to court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，申禁奸民妄立經會，私創庵舍，以避征徭，保伍容芘不覺察坐之。

translations.literal: On dingmao, it was proclaimed forbidden that wicked commoners recklessly establish scripture assemblies, privately create hermitages, and thereby evade levies and corvée; mutual-responsibility groups that shelter and fail to detect this are also liable to punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, an order forbade unscrupulous persons from founding unauthorized scripture assemblies and private hermitages to evade taxes and corvée duty; neighborhood mutual-responsibility groups that concealed such violations and failed to report them would be punished as well.

sentences.zh: 辛未，劉雄飛乞致仕。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Liu Xiongfei requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Liu Xiongfei petitioned to retire from office.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，孝感縣丞關應庚上書言邊防二十事，詔授武當軍節度推官兼司法，京湖制司量材任使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Guan Yinggeng, assistant magistrate of Xiaogan County, submitted a memorial on twenty matters of frontier defense; an edict appointed him judicial-assessor of the Wudang Army with concurrent judicial duty, to be employed according to his talents by the Jianghu strategic office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Guan Yinggeng, assistant magistrate of Xiaogan County, submitted a memorial on twenty frontier matters; an edict made him judicial-assessor of the Wudang Army with concurrent judicial duties, to be employed by the Jianghu strategic office as his talents allowed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，馬軍司統制王仙昔在襄、樊緣戰陷陣，今復來歸，特與官五轉，充殿前司正額統制，賜錢一萬。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Wang Xian of the Horse Guard, who had formerly been captured in battle at Xiang and Fan, now returned; he was specially granted five promotions in rank, appointed regular overall commander of the Palace Command, and granted ten thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wang Xian, overall commander of the Horse Guard, who had been captured in battle at Xiang and Fan, now returned to service; he was specially promoted five ranks, appointed a regular overall commander of the Palace Command, and given ten thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 布衣林椿年等上書言邊防十數事，詔諸人上書凡言請以丞相似道督視者不允，余付機速房。

translations.literal: Commoner Lin Chunnian and others submitted memorials on more than ten frontier matters; an edict stated that among the memorials, any petition that the Chancellor Jia Sidao oversee operations in person was denied; the rest were referred to the Secretariat for Rapid Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The commoner Lin Chunnian and others submitted memorials on more than ten frontier matters; an edict ruled that petitions calling for Chancellor Jia Sidao to oversee operations in person were denied, and the rest were forwarded to the Secretariat for Rapid Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，刑部尚書兼給事中陳宜中言，樊城之潰，牛富死節尤著，以職卑，贈恤下範天順一階，未愜輿情。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Chen Yizhong, Minister of Justice with concurrent duty as Supervising Secretariat Recipient, stated that when Fancheng fell, Niu Fu's death in faithful service was especially outstanding; because his rank was low, the posthumous honors fell one grade below Fan Tianshun, which did not satisfy public sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Chen Yizhong, Minister of Justice and concurrent Supervising Secretariat Recipient, reported that when Fancheng fell, Niu Fu's loyal death stood out above all others; yet because his rank was low, his posthumous honors were set one grade below Fan Tianshun's, which left public opinion unsatisfied.

sentences.zh: 詔加贈富寧遠軍承宣使，仍賜土田、金幣恤其家。

translations.literal: An edict additionally posthumously made him Military Commissioner of the Funing Remote Army, and still granted land, gold, and coin to comfort his family.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously promoted him to Military Commissioner of the Funing Remote Army and granted his family farmland, gold, and coin in consolation.

sentences.zh: 前四川宣撫司參議官張夢發詣賈似道，上書陳危急三策，曰鎮漢江口岸，曰城荊門軍當陽界之玉泉山，曰峽州宜都而下聯置堡砦，以保聚流民，且守且耕，並圖上城築形勢。

translations.literal: Zhang Mengfa, former deliberation officer of the Sichuan Pacification Commission, went to Jia Sidao and submitted a memorial presenting three urgent strategies: securing the Han River estuary, fortifying Yuquan Mountain on the Dangyang border in Jingmen Army, and establishing linked fortresses below Yidu in Kuizhou to gather displaced people, defending while farming; he also submitted diagrams of the proposed fortification terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Mengfa, former deliberation officer of the Sichuan Pacification Commission, went to Jia Sidao and submitted a memorial setting forth three urgent measures: hold the Han River crossings, fortify Yuquan Mountain on the Dangyang border in Jingmen Army, and build a chain of fortresses below Yidu in Kuizhou to shelter displaced people who would farm while holding the line; he also submitted diagrams of the proposed works.

sentences.zh: 賈似道不以上聞，下京湖制司審度可否，事竟不行。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao did not report it upward; he sent it down to the Jianghu strategic office to assess whether it was feasible, and in the end the plan was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao never reported the proposal to the throne; he referred it to the Jianghu strategic office for feasibility review, and the plan was never implemented.

sentences.zh: 成都安撫使昝萬壽去冬調將士攻毀成都大城，今春戰碉門，五月遣統制楊國寶領兵至雅州，統領趙忠領兵至眉州，兩路捍禦有勞，詔具將士宣力等第、姓名以聞。

translations.literal: Zan Wanshou, Chengdu Pacification Commissioner, last winter deployed officers and soldiers to attack and destroy the great wall of Chengdu; this spring he fought at Diaomen; in the fifth month he sent overall commander Yang Guobao to lead troops to Yazhou and commander Zhao Zhong to lead troops to Meizhou; both routes had labored in defense; an edict ordered a full report of the officers and soldiers by grade of exertion and name.
translations.idiomatic: Zan Wanshou, the Chengdu Pacification Commissioner, last winter deployed troops to assault and dismantle Chengdu's outer wall; this spring he fought at Diaomen; in the fifth month he sent overall commander Yang Guobao with troops to Yazhou and commander Zhao Zhong with troops to Meizhou. Both columns had borne the brunt of the defense. An edict called for a ranked list of the officers and soldiers who had exerted themselves, with names submitted in report.

sentences.zh: 呂文福言文煥爲人扶擁，以襄陽降非由己心。

translations.literal: Lü Wenfu stated that Wen Huan had been carried along by others and that his surrender of Xiangyang was not of his own will.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wenfu reported that Wen Huan had been coerced by others and that his surrender of Xiangyang had not reflected his own intent.

sentences.zh: 詔與李庭芝元陳異同，其審核以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered comparison with Li Tingzhi's original statement to determine agreement or disagreement, and that the review be reported.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that his account be compared with Li Tingzhi's original report, and that the findings be submitted after review.

sentences.zh: 庭芝表：「向在京湖，來歸人吳旺等備言文煥父子降狀，先納莞鑰，旋獻襄城，且陳策攻郢州，請自爲先鋒。

translations.literal: Tingzhi memorialized: "While I was in Jianghu, the returners Wu Wang and others fully described Wen Huan and his son's manner of surrender: first turning over the keys, then promptly presenting Xiangcheng, and moreover offering plans to attack Yingzhou, asking to serve himself as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi memorialized: "While I was in Jianghu, the returners Wu Wang and others gave a full account of Wen Huan and his son's surrender: first handing over the keys, then promptly yielding Xiangcheng, and even proposing a plan to attack Yingzhou, offering to serve as vanguard himself.

sentences.zh: 言人人同，制司案辭可征，非敢加誣人罪。

translations.literal: What was said was the same from every mouth; the strategic office's case records provide evidence; I do not dare to add a false charge against any man.
translations.idiomatic: The testimony was unanimous, and the strategic office records bear it out; I do not presume to levy a false charge against anyone.

sentences.zh: 」詔文福勉力捍禦，毋墜家聲。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Wenfu to exert himself in defense and not bring down the renown of his house.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict enjoined Wenfu to defend with all his strength and not disgrace his family's name.

sentences.zh: 京湖制司言：「去年冬間，探司總管劉儀、盛聰，總制趙鐸，領精銳至均州文龍崖立砦。

translations.literal: The Jianghu strategic office stated: "Last winter, reconnaissance office chief supervisors Liu Yi and Sheng Cong, and overall commander Zhao Duo, led elite troops to Wenlong Cliff in Junzhou and established a fort.
translations.idiomatic: The Jianghu strategic office reported: "Last winter, Liu Yi and Sheng Cong, chief supervisors of the reconnaissance office, and overall commander Zhao Duo led elite troops to Wenlong Cliff in Junzhou and established a stockade.

sentences.zh: 呂文煥既降，均城受敵，知郡劉懋偕劉儀等扞禦宣勞。

translations.literal: After Lü Wen Huan had surrendered, Jun city came under enemy attack; the prefect Liu Mao together with Liu Yi and others defended and proclaimed their labors.
translations.idiomatic: After Lü Wen Huan surrendered, Jun prefecture came under attack; prefect Liu Mao, together with Liu Yi and the others, held the line and reported their exertions.

sentences.zh: 」詔懋升右武大夫、帶行左衛大將軍，仍舊職，儀添差荊湖北路兵馬鈐轄，聰添差鄂州兵馬鈐轄，各官三轉，將士官兩轉。

translations.literal: " An edict promoted Mao to Right Martial Grandee with acting Left Guard Major General, retaining his former office; Yi was given special assignment as Hubei North Route military coordinator; Cong was given special assignment as Ezhou military coordinator; each was granted three promotions in rank, and officers and soldiers two promotions.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict promoted Liu Mao to Right Martial Grandee with acting rank of Left Guard Major General, while retaining his current post; Liu Yi was given special assignment as military coordinator on the northern Hubei route; Sheng Cong received special assignment as Ezhou military coordinator; each was promoted three ranks, and the officers and soldiers two.

sentences.zh: 左藏東庫蹇材望上書言邊事大可憂者七，急當爲者五。

translations.literal: Jian Caiwang of the Left Storehouse, Eastern Repository, submitted a memorial stating seven frontier matters of grave concern and five that urgently required action.
translations.idiomatic: Jian Caiwang of the Left Storehouse's Eastern Repository submitted a memorial identifying seven deeply worrying frontier problems and five measures that demanded immediate action.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No response was given.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial received no reply.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，劉雄飛卒，特贈一官。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Liu Xiongfei died; he was specially granted one posthumous rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Liu Xiongfei died; he was posthumously granted an additional rank.

sentences.zh: 戊子，京湖制司請給器械，詔內軍器庫選犀利者賜之，仍贈錢百萬備修繕。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Jianghu strategic office requested the provision of weapons; an edict ordered the Inner Armory to select sharp ones for grant, and additionally granted one million strings of cash for repairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Jianghu strategic office requested arms; an edict ordered the Inner Armory to supply its finest weapons and granted one million strings of cash for repairs.

sentences.zh: 四川制置朱禩孫言月奉銀計萬兩，願以犒師，向後月免請。

translations.literal: Zhu Huisun, Sichuan Commissioner for Military Affairs, stated that his monthly salary in silver amounted to ten thousand taels, which he wished to use to reward the troops, and asked hereafter to be exempted from monthly receipt.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Huisun, the Sichuan Commissioner for Military Affairs, reported that his monthly salary in silver came to ten thousand taels, which he wished to devote to rewarding the troops, and asked to forgo his monthly stipend thereafter.

sentences.zh: 詔常祿勿辭。

translations.literal: An edict stated that his regular salary was not to be declined.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed him to keep receiving his regular salary.

sentences.zh: 己丑，給事中陳宜中言，乞正範文虎不力援襄之罰，詔文虎降一官、依舊知安慶府。

translations.literal: On jichou, Supervising Secretariat Recipient Chen Yizhong stated, requesting that the penalty for Fan Wenhu's failure to rescue Xiangyang be corrected; an edict demoted Wenhu one rank but left him as before as prefect of Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Chen Yizhong, Supervising Secretariat Recipient, petitioned for proper punishment of Fan Wenhu's failure to relieve Xiangyang; an edict demoted Fan Wenhu one rank but allowed him to remain prefect of Anqing.

sentences.zh: 安南國進方物，特賜金五百兩、帛百匹。

translations.literal: Annam presented tribute goods; he was specially granted five hundred taels of gold and one hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: When Annam presented tribute, the court specially granted five hundred taels of gold and one hundred bolts of silk in return.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，汪立信言：「臣奉命分閫，延見吏民，皆痛哭流涕而言襄、樊之禍，皆由範文虎及俞興父子。

translations.literal: On guimao, Wang Lixin stated: "Having received command to govern a circuit, in meeting officials and commoners I find them all weeping and saying that the calamity of Xiang and Fan was entirely due to Fan Wenhu and Yu Xing, father and son.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wang Lixin reported: "Since taking command of this circuit, in every audience with officials and commoners alike I have heard them weeping that the fall of Xiang and Fan was owed entirely to Fan Wenhu and to Yu Xing and his son.

sentences.zh: 文虎以三衙長聞難怯戰，僅從薄罰，猶子天順守節不屈，猶或可以少贖其愆。

translations.literal: Wenhu, as a senior commander of the Three Commands, upon hearing of the crisis was cowardly in battle; he received only a light punishment. Yet his nephew Tianshun held to his post without yielding, by which perhaps his fault may be in some measure redeemed.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu, as a senior commander of the Three Commands, had shrunk from battle when the crisis came, yet received only a light penalty. His nephew Tianshun, however, held his post to the death without yielding — by that loyalty, perhaps Fan Wenhu's fault might be partly redeemed.

sentences.zh: 興奴僕庸材，器量褊淺，務復私仇，激成劉整之禍，流毒至今。

translations.literal: Xing was a base servile talent, narrow and shallow in capacity; he pursued private revenge, inciting the calamity of Liu Zheng; the poison flows to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xing was a servile mediocrity of narrow mind and shallow character; bent on private revenge, he had provoked the disaster of Liu Zheng, whose poison still afflicts the realm.

sentences.zh: 其子大忠挾多資爲父行賄，且自希榮進，今雖寸斬，未足以快天下之忿，乞置重典，則人心興起，事功可圖。

translations.literal: His son Dazhong, wielding abundant wealth, conducted bribery on his father's behalf and moreover hoped for his own advancement in glory; though now he were cut inch by inch, it would not suffice to satisfy the wrath of all under Heaven; I beg that severe statutes be applied, then the hearts of men will be roused and achievement may be plotted.
translations.idiomatic: His son Dazhong had wielded great wealth to bribe officials on his father's behalf while seeking advancement for himself; execution by inches would not satisfy the wrath of the realm. I beg that the severest penalties be imposed — only then will popular sentiment revive and great deeds become possible.

sentences.zh: 」詔俞大忠追毀出身文字，除名、循州拘管。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Yu Dazhong's career documents traced and destroyed, his name struck from the rolls, and assignment to supervised residence in Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Yu Dazhong's credentials revoked and destroyed, his name stricken from the rolls, and confinement under supervision in Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 又言守闕進義副尉童明，襄陽破，拔身來歸，且嘗立功開州，乞補轉四官。

translations.literal: He also stated that Palace Garrison Advance Righteousness Vice-Commander Tong Ming, when Xiangyang fell, extracted himself and came in submission, and moreover had once achieved merit at Kaizhou; he requested four promotions in rank.
translations.idiomatic: He also recommended Palace Garrison Advance Righteousness Vice-Commander Tong Ming, who when Xiangyang fell had escaped and returned to Song service and had once earned distinction at Kaizhou; he asked that Tong be promoted four ranks.

sentences.zh: 詔特與官兩轉。

translations.literal: An edict specially granted two promotions in rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him a special promotion of two ranks.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛亥，命殿前指揮使陳奕總統舟師備鄂州、黃州江防。

translations.literal: On xinhai in the intercalary month, Palace Front commander Chen Yi was ordered to command overall the river forces to prepare the river defenses of Ezhou and Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the intercalary month, Chen Yi, commander of the Palace Front, was ordered to take overall command of the fleet and prepare the river defenses of Ezhou and Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，來歸人郭珍補成忠郎，張進、張春、張德林、向德成、王全、婁德、王興各補承信郎。

translations.literal: On guichou, the returner Guo Zhen was appointed Chenzhong Lang; Zhang Jin, Zhang Chun, Zhang Delin, Xiang Decheng, Wang Quan, Lou De, and Wang Xing were each appointed Chengxin Lang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the returner Guo Zhen was appointed Chenzhong Lang, and Zhang Jin, Zhang Chun, Zhang Delin, Xiang Decheng, Wang Quan, Lou De, and Wang Xing were each appointed Chengxin Lang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，朝散郎師顯行進《注皇朝文鑒》。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Retired Gentleman Shi Xian submitted the Annotated Imperial Dynasty Literary Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Retired Gentleman Shi Xian presented his Annotated Imperial Dynasty Literary Mirror.

sentences.zh: 前臨安府司法梁炎午陳攻守之要五事，不報。

translations.literal: Former Lin'an prefectural legal officer Liang Yanwu presented five essentials of attack and defense; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: Former Lin'an prefectural legal officer Liang Yanwu submitted five strategic points on attack and defense; the court took no action.

sentences.zh: 命大理寺丞鐘蜚英點視沿江堡隘兵船，戊辰，知敘州郭漢傑言，馬湖蠻王汝作、鹿巫蠻王沐丘，帥蠻兵五百餘助官軍民義阻險馬湖，捍禦有功。

translations.literal: An order was issued to Dali Temple Assistant Commissioner Zhong Feiying to inspect fortresses, passes, and military vessels along the river; on wuchen, prefect of Xuzhou Guo Hanjie reported that Ma Lake barbarian king Ruzuo and Luhu barbarian king Muqiu had led more than five hundred barbarian soldiers together with government troops and civilian volunteers to hold the defiles at Ma Lake in defense, achieving merit in resistance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Feiying, assistant commissioner of the Dali Court, was ordered to inspect the river fortresses, passes, and war vessels. On wuchen, Guo Hanjie, prefect of Xuzhou, reported that the Ma Lake tribal king Ruzuo and the Luhu tribal king Muqiu had led more than five hundred tribal warriors, together with regular troops and local volunteers, to hold the Ma Lake defiles against the enemy with distinction.

sentences.zh: 詔賞汝作、沐丘金帛及其部兵有差。

translations.literal: An edict rewarded Ruzuo and Muqiu with gold and silks, and their subordinate soldiers in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Ruzuo and Muqiu gold and silk, with rewards distributed in proportion among their followers.

sentences.zh: 敘州總管曹順一軍，凡在戰陣者，趣具立功等第來上。

translations.literal: Cao Shun's army as Xuzhou chief commander — all who had been in battle were urgently ordered to compile grades of merit achieved and submit them upward.
translations.idiomatic: As for the army of Xuzhou chief commander Cao Shun, all who had fought were ordered to submit ranked lists of their achievements without delay.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，權紹興府節制紫城軍義文榮鼎及將校趙居敬、丁福、孟青、蒲祥、白貴、史用、羅宜、王繁等九人，成都之役沒於兵，各追贈官秩，仍官其子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, acting Shaoxing prefect and Zicheng Army controller Wen Rongding and the nine officers Zhao Jujing, Ding Fu, Meng Qing, Pu Xiang, Bai Gui, Shi Yong, Luo Yi, and Wang Fan — in the Chengdu campaign all perished in battle; posthumous ranks were granted to each, and their sons were still given office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, Wen Rongding, acting prefect of Shaoxing and controller of the Zicheng Army, and nine officers — Zhao Jujing, Ding Fu, Meng Qing, Pu Xiang, Bai Gui, Shi Yong, Luo Yi, and Wang Fan — were killed in the Chengdu campaign. Posthumous ranks were granted to each, and their sons were appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，知達州趙章、知開州鮮汝忠、知渠州張資等復洋州。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zhao Zhang, prefect of Dazhou; Xian Ruzhong, prefect of Kaizhou; Zhang Zi, prefect of Quzhou, and others recovered Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhao Zhang of Dazhou, Xian Ruzhong of Kaizhou, Zhang Zi of Qu Prefecture, and others recovered Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，張玨等復馬騣山。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Zhang Jue and others recovered Ma Zong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zhang Jue and his forces recovered Mount Ma Zong.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，權知均州徐鼎、總管盛聰戰房州胡師峪、板倉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on guichou, acting Junzhou prefect Xu Ding and chief commander Sheng Cong fought at Hushiyu and Bancang in Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, Xu Ding, acting prefect of Junzhou, and chief commander Sheng Cong fought at Hushiyu and Bancang in Fang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，知房州李鑒調權竹山縣王國材、統制熊權、總轄馬宗明，戰落馬坪、白羊山，詔有司各以勞效論賞。

translations.literal: On yimao, Fangzhou prefect Li Jian deployed acting Zhushan county magistrate Wang Guocai, overall commander Xiong Quan, and chief supervisor Ma Zongming; they fought at Luomaping and Baiyang Mountain; an edict ordered the responsible offices to reward each according to merit of labor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Li Jian, prefect of Fangzhou, deployed Wang Guocai, acting magistrate of Zhushan County, overall commander Xiong Quan, and chief supervisor Ma Zongming in battle at Luomaping and Baiyang Mountain. An edict directed the responsible offices to reward each according to merit.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，以章鑒簽書樞密院事兼參知政事，陳宜中同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on xinsi, Zhang Jian was appointed Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Vice Grand Councillor; Chen Yizhong was appointed the same Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi, Zhang Jian was appointed Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Grand Councillor, and Chen Yizhong was appointed Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs as well.

sentences.zh: 成都安撫使昝萬壽城嘉定烏尤山。

translations.literal: Chengdu Pacification Commissioner Zan Wanshou fortified Wuyou Mountain at Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: Zan Wanshou, the Chengdu Pacification Commissioner, fortified Wuyou Mountain at Jiading.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以洪燾爲浙東安撫使。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Hong Yan was appointed Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Hong Yan was appointed Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以黃萬石爲湖南安撫使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Huang Wanshi was appointed Hunan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Huang Wanshi was appointed Hunan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，來歸人汪福、許文政各官五轉。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiyou, the returners Wang Fu and Xu Wenzheng were each granted five promotions in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou, the returners Wang Fu and Xu Wenzheng were each promoted five ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，鎮巢軍、和州、太平州諸將查文、李文用、孟浩等十一人，以射湖岡、萬歲嶺、後港及焦湖北岸戰功，鹹賜爵賞。

translations.literal: On guichou, the eleven generals Cha Wen, Li Wenyong, Meng Hao, and others of Zhenchao Army, Hezhou, and Taipingzhou — for merit in battle at Shehugang, Wansuiling, Hougang, and the north bank of Jiao Lake — were all granted noble ranks and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, eleven officers of Zhenchao Army, He Prefecture, and Taiping Prefecture — Cha Wen, Li Wenyong, Meng Hao, and the rest — were granted noble titles and rewards for their victories at Shehugang, Wansuiling, Hougang, and the north shore of Jiao Lake.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，雷。

translations.literal: On guihai, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 四川制司言何炎向失洋州，調知達州趙章等率諸部軍義復之；

translations.literal: The Sichuan strategic office stated that He Yan had earlier lost Yang Prefecture; Zhao Zhang, prefect of Dazhou, and others were deployed and led the various detachments of army volunteers to recover it;
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan strategic office reported that He Yan had earlier lost Yang Prefecture, and that Zhao Zhang of Dazhou, once deployed there, had led regional troops and local volunteers to recover it;

sentences.zh: 七月又復洋州、吳勝堡兩城，權檄統轄謝益知洋州，總制趙桂楫知巴州，俾任責吳勝堡戰守之事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they again recovered Yang Prefecture and the two walled places of Wusheng Fort; provisional orders appointed coordinator Xie Yi as prefect of Yang Prefecture and overall commander Zhao Guiji as prefect of Bazhou, enabling them to bear responsibility for battle and defense at Wusheng Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they recovered Yang Prefecture and Wusheng Fort as well, with provisional orders placing coordinator Xie Yi in charge of Yang Prefecture and overall commander Zhao Guiji in charge of Ba Prefecture, charged with defending Wusheng Fort.

sentences.zh: 至是以功來上，且以二州攝事守臣請命於朝，詔與正授。

translations.literal: At this time the merit was submitted upward, and moreover the acting prefects holding charge of the two prefectures requested formal appointment from the court; an edict granted regular appointment.
translations.idiomatic: They now reported their achievements, and the interim prefects of the two prefectures asked the court for formal appointments; an edict confirmed them in regular office.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，兩淮制置使印應雷告老，進二秩致仕。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Liang-Huai strategic commissioner Yin Yinglei requested retirement on account of age; he was promoted two ranks and granted retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Yin Yinglei, strategic commissioner of the Two Huai circuits, sought retirement; he was promoted two ranks and granted leave to retire.

sentences.zh: 李庭芝兩淮安撫制置使，賜錢二百萬激犒備禦。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi was appointed Two-Huai Pacification and Strategic Commissioner; two million in cash was granted to stimulate rewards and prepare defense.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi was appointed Pacification and Strategic Commissioner of the Two Huai circuits, and two million in cash was granted to reward the troops and fund defenses.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，子㬎授左衛上將軍，封嘉國公。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on renwu, the son Xian was appointed Left Guard Senior General and enfeoffed as Duke of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, the heir Xian was appointed Left Guard Senior General and created Duke of Jia.

sentences.zh: 戊子，知泰州龔准遣其將王大顯等捍禦水砦有功，又獲俘民以還，詔水步兩軍將校凡用命者賞激有差。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Taizhou prefect Gong Zhun dispatched his generals Wang Daxian and others to defend water forts with merit; they also captured captive commoners and returned them; an edict rewarded the naval and infantry officers and soldiers who had exerted themselves, in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Gong Zhun, prefect of Taizhou, sent his generals Wang Daxian and others to hold the river forts with distinction, and they also recovered captives. An edict granted graded rewards to the officers and soldiers of the river and land forces who had fought with resolve.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以夏貴爲淮西制置使兼知廬州，陳奕沿江制置使兼知黃州，呂文福知閣門事。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Xia Gui was appointed Huai-West strategic commissioner concurrently prefect of Luzhou; Chen Yi was appointed Along-the-River strategic commissioner concurrently prefect of Huangzhou; Lü Wenfu was appointed Gate Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Xia Gui was appointed strategic commissioner of Huai West and concurrent prefect of Luzhou; Chen Yi was appointed strategic commissioner Along the River and concurrent prefect of Huangzhou; and Lü Wenfu was appointed Gate Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 詔從李庭芝請分淮東、西制置爲兩司，就命庭芝交割淮東，仍兼淮西策應使。

translations.literal: An edict followed Li Tingzhi's request to divide Huai-East and Huai-West strategic commissions into two offices; Tingzhi was thereupon ordered to take over Huai-East, still concurrently serving as Huai-West support envoy.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Li Tingzhi's request to divide the Huai East and Huai West strategic commissions into separate offices; Tingzhi was immediately ordered to assume Huai East while retaining his role as Huai West support commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以夏貴爲淮西安撫制置使，賜錢百萬激犒備禦。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Xia Gui was appointed Huai-An Pacification and Strategic Commissioner; one million in cash was granted to stimulate rewards and prepare defense.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Xia Gui was appointed Pacification and Strategic Commissioner of Huai-An, and one million in cash was granted to reward the troops and fund defenses.

sentences.zh: 李庭芝辭免淮西策應使，不允。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi declined and sought dismissal from the Huai-West support envoy post; this was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi sought release from the Huai West support commissioner post; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 知安豐軍陳萬以舟師自城西大澗口抵正陽城，遇北兵力戰，詔旌其勞。

translations.literal: Anfeng Army prefect Chen Wan, with river forces from the great ravine mouth west of the city to Zhengyang city, encountered Northern troops and fought fiercely; an edict commended his labors.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wan, prefect of Anfeng Army, led his fleet from the great ravine west of the city to Zhengyang and fought a pitched battle with the northern forces; an edict commended his exertions.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，以馬廷鸞爲浙東安撫使、知紹興府。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on jiazi, Ma Tingluan was appointed Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi, Ma Tingluan was appointed Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，權參知政事章鑒再乞解機政，不允。

translations.literal: On bingyin, acting Vice Grand Councillor Zhang Jian again begged release from state affairs; this was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhang Jian, acting Vice Grand Councillor, again petitioned to retire from the machinery of government; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，沿江制置使所轄四郡夏秋旱澇，免屯田租二十五萬石。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the four prefectures under the Along-the-River strategic commissioner suffered drought and floods in summer and autumn; garrison-field rent of two hundred fifty thousand shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, drought and flood afflicted the four prefectures under the Along-the-River strategic commissioner in summer and autumn; garrison-field rent of two hundred fifty thousand shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月壬午，城鄂州漢口堡。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on renwu, the fortress at Hankou in Ezhou was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on renwu, fortifications were built at the Hankou stockade in E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 權總制施忠、部將熊伯明、知泰州龔准以天長縣東橫山、秦潼湖、青蒲口等處戰功推賞。

translations.literal: Acting overall commander Shi Zhong, subordinate officer Xiong Boming, and Taizhou prefect Gong Zhun were recommended for reward for merit in battle at Dongheng Mountain, Qintong Lake, Qingpukou, and other places in Tianchang County.
translations.idiomatic: Acting overall commander Shi Zhong, his subordinate Xiong Boming, and Taizhou prefect Gong Zhun were recommended for rewards for their victories at Dongheng Mountain, Qintong Lake, Qingpukou, and other points in Tianchang County.

sentences.zh: 戊子，江萬里以疾辭職任，詔依舊觀文殿大學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Jiang Wanli resigned his duties on account of illness; an edict ordered that he retain his former title of Observing Literature Hall Grand Academician and Director of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Jiang Wanli resigned on grounds of illness; an edict allowed him to retain his rank as Observing Literature Hall Grand Academician and his appointment as Director of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以留夢炎知潭州兼湖南安撫使。

translations.literal: On yichou, Liu Mengyan was appointed prefect of Tanzhou concurrently Hunan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Liu Mengyan was appointed prefect of Tanzhou and Hunan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，城鄂州沌口西岸堡。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the fortress on the west bank at Dunkou in Ezhou was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, fortifications were raised at the west-bank stockade at Dunkou in E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 京湖制司言襄陽勇信中軍鈐轄吳信隨呂文煥北往，今並妻子冒險來歸。

translations.literal: The Jianghu strategic office stated that Xiangyang Brave-Faith Middle Army coordinator Wu Xin had followed Lü Wen Huan northward; now together with wife and children he had risked danger to come in submission.
translations.idiomatic: The Jianghu strategic office reported that Wu Xin, military coordinator of the Xiangyang Brave-Faith Middle Army, had followed Lü Wen Huan north, but now had returned with his wife and children at great personal risk.

sentences.zh: 詔吳信赴闕，制司仍存恤其家。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wu Xin to proceed to court; the strategic office was still to preserve and comfort his family.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Wu Xin to court, while the strategic office was directed to continue providing for his family.

sentences.zh: 丙申，江東沙圩租米，以咸淳九年水災，詔減什四。

translations.literal: On bingshen, sand-dyke rent rice in Jiangdong — because of flood disaster in the ninth year of Xianchun — an edict ordered reduction of four parts in ten.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, because of the floods of the ninth year of Xianchun, an edict reduced sand-dyke rent rice in eastern Jiang by forty percent.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，雨土。

translations.literal: On yisi, earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，以趙順孫爲福建安撫使。

translations.literal: In the second month on jiyou, Zhao Shunsun was appointed Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiyou, Zhao Shunsun was appointed Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔諸制閫就任升除恩數，其告命、衣帶、鞍馬，閣門勿差人給賜，往要厚賂，以失優寵制臣之意，違者有刑。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict ordered that for the promotion and appointment honors of the various circuit commanders upon taking office, the patent of appointment, robes, belt, saddle, and horse — the Gate Office must not dispatch persons to deliver and grant them, as they had previously demanded heavy bribes, thus failing the intent of honoring favored circuit ministers; violators would face punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, an edict ruled that when circuit commanders received their promotions and appointment honors upon taking office, the Gate Office was forbidden to send envoys to deliver patents, robes, belts, saddles, and horses — envoys who had too often demanded heavy bribes and thus betrayed the court's intent to honor its frontier ministers. Violators would be punished.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，免郡縣侵負義倉米七十四萬八千余石。

translations.literal: In the third month on jimao, encroached and owed Righteous Granary rice of counties and prefectures — seven hundred forty-eight thousand-odd shi — was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, unpaid and misappropriated Righteous Granary rice owed by prefectures and counties — more than 748,000 shi — was remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，子昺授左衛上將軍，進封永國公。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on yimao, the son Bing was appointed Left Guard Senior General and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, the prince Bing was appointed Left Guard Senior General and advanced to Duke of Yong.

sentences.zh: 詔賞沿江都統王達、黃俁戰黃連寺之功。

translations.literal: An edict rewarded overall commanders along the river Wang Da and Huang Yi for merit in battle at Huangliansi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rewarded riverine overall commanders Wang Da and Huang Yi for their victory at Huanglian Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以呂文福爲常德、辰、沅、澧、靖五郡鎮撫使、知沅州。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Lü Wenfu was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the five prefectures Changde, Chen, Yuan, Li, and Jing, concurrently prefect of Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Lü Wenfu was appointed pacification commissioner of the five prefectures of Changde, Chen, Yuan, Li, and Jing, and concurrent prefect of Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔賞光州守陳岩、路分李全、許彥德、總管何成、路鈐仰子虎等牛市畈、丁家莊戰功。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict rewarded Guangzhou prefect Chen Yan, route commander Li Quan, Xu Yande, chief commander He Cheng, route coordinator Yang Zihu, and others for merit in battle at Niushichang and Dingjiazhuang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, an edict rewarded Chen Yan, prefect of Guang Prefecture, route commander Li Quan, Xu Yande, chief commander He Cheng, route coordinator Yang Zihu, and others for their victories at Niushichang and Dingjiazhuang.

sentences.zh: 烏蘇蠻王詣雲南軍前納款大元。

translations.literal: The Wusu barbarian king went to the Yun'nan army front to submit allegiance to Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusu tribal king went to the Yun'nan front to submit to the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，以高世傑爲湖北安撫副使兼知岳州，總統出戍軍馬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on dinghai, Gao Shijie was appointed Hubei Pacification Vice-Commissioner concurrently prefect of Yuezhou, commanding overall the garrison and field armies deployed outward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dinghai, Gao Shijie was appointed vice commissioner of Hubei pacification and concurrent prefect of Yue Prefecture, with overall command of the garrison and field armies on outward deployment.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，馬廷鸞辭免觀文殿大學士、知紹興府、浙東安撫使，詔不允。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Ma Tingluan declined and sought dismissal from Observing Literature Hall Grand Academician, Shaoxing prefect, and Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner; an edict did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Ma Tingluan sought release from his posts as Observing Literature Hall Grand Academician, prefect of Shaoxing, and Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，張玨表請城馬騣、虎頭兩山，或先築其一，以據險要。

translations.literal: On renyin, Zhang Jue submitted a memorial requesting fortification of the two mountains Ma Zong and Hutou, or first building one of them, in order to hold strategic defiles.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhang Jue memorialized asking permission to fortify Mount Ma Zong and Mount Hutou — or at least one of them first — to hold the strategic heights.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，以銀二萬兩命壽春府措置邊防。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on wuwu, twenty thousand taels of silver were ordered for Shouchun Prefecture to arrange border defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuwu, twenty thousand taels of silver were allocated to Shouchun Prefecture for border defense.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，汪立信乞致仕，不允。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on renwu, Wang Lixin begged retirement; this was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu, Wang Lixin sought retirement; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝崩于福寧殿，遺詔太子㬎即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor died in the Hall of Fortunate Tranquility; the final edict ordered the Crown Prince Xian to ascend the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Emperor died in the Hall of Fortunate Tranquility; his final edict installed Crown Prince Xian on the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲申，台臣劾內醫蔡幼習，詔奪五秩，送五百里州軍居住，二子並罷閣門職。

translations.literal: On jiashen, censorial officials impeached Inner Physician Cai Youxi; an edict stripped five ranks, sent him to reside in a prefecture five hundred li distant, and both sons were also dismissed from Gate Office posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, censorial officials impeached the court physician Cai Youxi; an edict stripped him of five ranks and banished him to a prefecture five hundred li distant, and both his sons were dismissed from their Gate Office posts.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，上大行皇帝諡曰端文明武景孝皇帝，廟號度宗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiyou, the late Emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor Duanwen Mingwu Jingxiao, with temple name Duzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the late Emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor Duanwen Mingwu Jingxiao, with temple name Duzong.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年正月壬午，葬於永紹陵。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Deyou, on renwu, he was buried at Yongshao Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Deyou, on renwu, he was interred at Yongshao Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：宋至理宗，疆宇日蹙，賈似道執國命。

translations.literal: Eulogy says: From Song's reaching Lizong, the realm daily contracted; Jia Sidao held the nation's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy reads: By the time of Lizong, Song territory had been shrinking day by day, and Jia Sidao held the nation's fate in his hands.

sentences.zh: 度宗繼統，雖無大失德，而拱手權奸，衰敝寢甚。

translations.literal: Duzong succeeded to the throne; although without great loss of virtue, he folded his hands before the powerful traitor, and decline and exhaustion daily worsened.
translations.idiomatic: Duzong succeeded to the throne without grave personal failings, yet he surrendered power to a treacherous minister, and the dynasty's decay grew ever worse.

sentences.zh: 考其當時事勢，非有雄才睿略之主，豈能振起其墜緒哉！

translations.literal: Examining the circumstances of that time, without a lord of heroic talent and wise strategy, how could the fallen line be revived!
translations.idiomatic: Given the circumstances of the age, only a ruler of heroic talent and far-reaching vision could have revived a dynasty already in free fall.

sentences.zh: 歷數有歸，宋祚尋訖，亡國不於其身，幸矣。

translations.literal: The cycle of mandate had its destination; Song's fortune soon ended; that the state perished not in his own person — fortunate indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate had already found its destination; the Song were soon to perish. That the dynasty fell not during his own reign was, perhaps, his one mercy.
